sections.label: A glorification of Trita and Varuna
sections.name: Hymn 1

verses.sa:
ऋधङ्मन्त्रो योनिं य आबभूवामतासुर्वर्धमानः सुजन्मा ।
अदब्धासुर्भ्राजमानोऽहेव त्रितो धर्ता दाधार त्रीणि॥
verses.tr: ṛdhaṅmantro yoniṃ ya ābabhūvāmatāsurvardhamānaḥ sujanmā adabdhāsurbhrājamāno'heva trito dhartā dādhāra trīṇi
verses.en: He who with special plans and deathless spirit, waxing, well-born, hath come unto his birth-place, As he who shines upholds the days, thus Trita, of pure life, bears the Three as their supporter.

verses.sa:
आ यो धर्माणि प्रथमः ससाद ततो वपूंषि कृणुषे पुरूणि ।
धास्युर्योनिं प्रथम आ विवेशा यो वाचमनुदितां चिकेत॥
verses.tr: ā yo dharmāṇi prathamaḥ sasāda tato vapūṃṣi kṛṇuṣe purūṇi dhāsyuryoniṃ prathama ā viveśā yo vācamanuditāṃ ciketa
verses.en: He who, the first, approached the holy statutes makes, after, many beauteous forms and figures. Eager to drink, his birth-place first he entered who understands the word when yet unspoken.

verses.sa:
यस्ते शोकाय तन्वंऽ रिरेच क्षरद्धिरण्यं शुचयोऽनु स्वाः ।
अत्रा दधेते अमतानि नामास्मे वस्त्राणि विश एरयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: yaste śokāya tanvaṃ' rireca kṣaraddhiraṇyaṃ śucayo'nu svāḥ atrā dadhete amatāni nāmāsme vastrāṇi viśa erayantām
verses.en: He who—"the fluid gold, with radiant kinsmen—to fervent glow delivered up thy body, On him both set names that shall live for ever: to him the regions shall send robes to clothe him.

verses.sa:
प्र यदेते प्रतरं पूर्व्यं गुः सदःसद आतिष्ठन्तो अजुर्यम्।
कविः शुषस्य मातरा रिहाणे जाम्यै धुर्यं पतिमेरयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: pra yadete prataraṃ pūrvyaṃ guḥ sadaḥsada ātiṣṭhanto ajuryam kaviḥ śuṣasya mātarā rihāṇe jāmyai dhuryaṃ patimerayethām
verses.en: As these have gone to their primeval station, each gaining an imperishable dwelling, May kissing mothers of the bards' beloved bring the pole-drawing husband to the sister.

verses.sa:
तदू षु ते महत् पृथुज्मन् नमः कविः काव्येन कृणोमि ।
यत् सम्यञ्चावभियन्तावभि क्षामत्रा मही रोधचक्रे वावृधेते॥
verses.tr: tadū ṣu te mahat pṛthujman namaḥ kaviḥ kāvyena kṛṇomi yat samyañcāvabhiyantāvabhi kṣāmatrā mahī rodhacakre vāvṛdhete
verses.en: By holy wisdom I a sage, Far-strider! offer to thee this lofty adoration. This worship both the mighty eddying rivers, coming together to this station, heighten.

verses.sa:
सप्त मर्यादाः कवयस्ततक्षुस्तासामिदेकामभ्यंऽहुरो गात्।
आयोर्ह स्कम्भ उपमस्य नीडे पथां विसर्गे धरुणेषु तस्थौ॥
verses.tr: sapta maryādāḥ kavayastatakṣustāsāmidekāmabhyaṃ'huro gāt āyorha skambha upamasya nīḍe pathāṃ visarge dharuṇeṣu tasthau
verses.en: Seven are the pathways which the wise have fashioned: to one of these may come the troubled mortal. On sure ground where the ways are parted standeth Life's Pillar in the dwelling of the Highest.

verses.sa:
उतामृतासुर्व्रत एमि कृन्वन्नसुरात्मा तन्व१स्तत् सुमद्गुः ।
उत वा शक्रो रत्नं दधात्यूर्जया वा यत् सचते हविर्दाः॥
verses.tr: utāmṛtāsurvrata emi kṛnvannasurātmā tanva1stat sumadguḥ uta vā śakro ratnaṃ dadhātyūrjayā vā yat sacate havirdāḥ
verses.en: Working, I go my way with deathless spirit; life, spirit, bodies have gone gladly thither. Aye, Sakra also gives his gift of treasure as when the sacrificer meets with power.

verses.sa:
उत पुत्रः पितरं क्षत्रमीडे ज्येष्ठं मर्यादमह्वयन्त्स्वस्तये ।
दर्शन् नु ता वरुण यास्ते विष्ठा आवर्व्रततः कृणवो वपूंषि॥
verses.tr: uta putraḥ pitaraṃ kṣatramīḍe jyeṣṭhaṃ maryādamahvayantsvastaye darśan nu tā varuṇa yāste viṣṭhā āvarvratataḥ kṛṇavo vapūṃṣi
verses.en: Yea, the son asks dominion of his father: this they declared the noblest path to welfare. Varuna, let them see thy revelations: display the wondrous shapes of times to follow.

verses.sa:
अर्धमर्धेन पयसा पृणक्ष्यर्धेन शुष्म वर्धसे अमुर ।
अविं वृधाम शग्मियं सखायं वरुणं पुत्रमदित्या इषिरम्।
कविशस्तान्यस्मै वपूंष्यवोचाम रोदसी सत्यवाचा॥
verses.tr: ardhamardhena payasā pṛṇakṣyardhena śuṣma vardhase amura aviṃ vṛdhāma śagmiyaṃ sakhāyaṃ varuṇaṃ putramadityā iṣiram kaviśastānyasmai vapūṃṣyavocāma rodasī satyavācā
verses.en: Half with the milk, its other half, thou mingles, and with that half, strong! unbeguiled! increases. Let us exalt the gracious friend, the mighty, Varuna son of Aditi, strength-giver. We have told him the marvels sung by poets. The utterance of Heaven and Earth is truthful.

sections.label: A glorification of Indra
sections.name: Hymn 2

verses.sa:
तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठं यतो यज्ञ उग्र स्त्वेषनृम्णः ।
सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यदेनं मदन्ति विश्व ऊमाः॥
verses.tr: tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato yajña ugra stveṣanṛmṇaḥ sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yadenaṃ madanti viśva ūmāḥ
verses.en: In all the worlds That was the best and highest whence sprang the Mighty One of splendid valour. As-soon as born he overcomes his foemen, when those rejoice in him who bring him succour,

verses.sa:
वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति ।
अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti avyanacca vyanacca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu
verses.en: Grown mighty in his strength, with ample vigour, he as a foe strikes fear into the Dasa, Eager to win the breathing and the breathless: All sang thy praise at banquet and oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वे क्रतुमपि पृञ्चन्ति भूरि द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः ।
स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः॥
verses.tr: tve kratumapi pṛñcanti bhūri dviryadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ
verses.en: All concentrate on thee their mental vigour what time these, twice or thrice, are thine assistants. Blend what is sweeter than the sweet with sweetness: win quickly with our meath that meath in battle.

verses.sa:
यदि चिन्नु त्वा धना जयन्तं रणेरणे अनुमदन्ति विप्राः ।
ओजीयः शुष्मिन्त्स्थिरमा तनुष्व मा त्वा दभन् दुरेवासः कशोकाः॥
verses.tr: yadi cinnu tvā dhanā jayantaṃ raṇeraṇe anumadanti viprāḥ ojīyaḥ śuṣmintsthiramā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan durevāsaḥ kaśokāḥ
verses.en: If verily in every war the sages joy and exult in thee who winnest treasures, With mightier power, strong God, extend thy firmness: let not malevolent Kusikas harm thee.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं शाशद्महे रणेषु प्रपश्यन्तो युधेन्यानि भूरि ।
चोदयामि त आयुधा वचोभिः सं ते शिशामि ब्रह्मणा वयांसि॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śiśāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi
verses.en: Proudly we put our trust in thee in battles, when we behold great wealth the prize of combat. I with my words impel thy weapons onward, and sharpen with my prayer thy vital vigour.

verses.sa:
नि तद् दधिषेऽवरे परे च यस्मिन्नाविथावसा दुरोणे।
आ स्थापयत मातरं जिगत्नुमत इन्वत कर्वराणि भूरि॥
verses.tr: ni tad dadhiṣe'vare pare ca yasminnāvithāvasā duroṇe ā sthāpayata mātaraṃ jigatnumata invata karvarāṇi bhūri
verses.en: Thou in that house, the highest or the lowest, which thy protection guards, bestowest riches. Establish ye the ever-wandering mother, and bring full many deeds to their completion.

verses.sa:
स्तुष्व वर्ष्मन् पुरुवर्त्मानं समृभ्वाणमिनतममाप्तमाप्त्यानाम्।
आ दर्शति शवसा भूर्योजाः प्र सक्षति प्रतिमानं पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: stuṣva varṣman puruvartmānaṃ samṛbhvāṇaminatamamāptamāptyānām ā darśati śavasā bhūryojāḥ pra sakṣati pratimānaṃ pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: Praise in the height him who 'hath many pathways, courageous, strongest, Aptya of the Aptyas. Through strength he shows himself of ample power: I pattern of Prithivi, he fights and conquers.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्म बृहद्दिवः कृणवदिन्द्राय शूषमग्रियः स्वर्षाः ।
महो गोत्रस्य क्षयति स्वराजा तुरश्चिद् विश्वमर्णवत् तपस्वान्॥
verses.tr: imā brahma bṛhaddivaḥ kṛṇavadindrāya śūṣamagriyaḥ svarṣāḥ maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājā turaścid viśvamarṇavat tapasvān
verses.en: Brihaddiva, the foremost of light-winners, hath made these holy prayers, this strength for Indra. Free Lord, he rules the mighty fold of cattle, winning, aglow, even all the billowy waters.

verses.sa:
एवा महान् बृहद्दिवो अथर्वावोचत् स्वां तन्व१मिन्द्रमेव।
स्वसारौ मातरिभ्वरी अरिप्रे हिन्वन्ति चैने शवसा वर्धयन्ति च॥
verses.tr: evā mahān bṛhaddivo atharvāvocat svāṃ tanva1mindrameva svasārau mātaribhvarī aripre hinvanti caine śavasā vardhayanti ca
verses.en: Thus hath Brihaddiva, the great Atharvan, spoken to Indra as himself in person. Two sisters free from stain, the Matarisvans, with power impel him onward and exalt him.

sections.label: A prayer to Agni, Indra, and other deities for victory and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 3

verses.sa:
ममाग्ने वर्चो विहवेष्वस्तु वयं त्वेन्धानास्तन्वंऽपुषेम ।
मह्यं नमन्तां प्रदिशश्चतस्रस्त्वयाध्यक्षेण पृतना जयेम॥
verses.tr: mamāgne varco vihaveṣvastu vayaṃ tvendhānāstanvaṃ'puṣema mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaścatasrastvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema
verses.en: Let strength be mine while I invoke thee, Agni! enkindling thee may we support our bodies. May the four regions bend and bow before me: with thee for guardian may we win the combat.

verses.sa:
अग्ने मन्युं प्रतिनुदन् परेषां त्वं नो गोपाः परि पाहि विश्वतः ।
अपाञ्चो यन्तु निवता दुरस्यवोऽमैषां चित्तं प्रबुधां वि नेशत्॥
verses.tr: agne manyuṃ pratinudan pareṣāṃ tvaṃ no gopāḥ pari pāhi viśvataḥ apāñco yantu nivatā durasyavo'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ prabudhāṃ vi neśat
verses.en: Baffling the range of our opponents, Agni! guard us as our protector round about us. Down the steep slope go they who hate us, backward, and let their thought who watch at home be ruined.

verses.sa:
मम देवा विहवे सन्तु सर्व इन्द्रवन्तो मरुतो विष्णुरग्निः ।
ममान्तरिक्षमुरुलोकमस्तु मह्यं वातः पवतां कामायास्मै॥
verses.tr: mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇuragniḥ mamāntarikṣamurulokamastu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāmāyāsmai
verses.en: May all the Gods be on my side in battle, the Maruts led by Indra, Vishnu, Agni. Mine be the middle air's extended region, and may the Wind blow favouring these my wishes.

verses.sa:
मह्यं यजन्तां मम यानीष्टाकूतिः सत्या मनसो मे अस्तु ।
एनो मा नि गां कतमच्चनाहं विश्वे देवा अभि रक्षन्तु मेह॥
verses.tr: mahyaṃ yajantāṃ mama yānīṣṭākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu eno mā ni gāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ viśve devā abhi rakṣantu meha
verses.en: For me let them present all mine oblations, and let my mind's intention be accomplished. May I be guiltless of the least transgression: may all the Gods come hither and protect me.

verses.sa:
मयि देवा द्रविणमा यजन्तां मय्याशीरस्तु मयि देवहूतिः ।
दैवाः होतारः सनिषन्न एतदरिष्टाः स्याम तन्वाऽसुवीराः॥
verses.tr: mayi devā draviṇamā yajantāṃ mayyāśīrastu mayi devahūtiḥ daivāḥ hotāraḥ saniṣanna etadariṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā'suvīrāḥ
verses.en: May the Gods grant me riches, may the blessing and invocation of the Gods assist me. This boon shall the celestial Hotars win us: may we, unwounded, have brave heroes round us.

verses.sa:
दैवीः षडुर्वीरुरु नः कृणोत विश्वे देवास इह मादयध्वम्।
मा नो विददभिभा मो अशस्तिर्मा नो विदद् वृजिना द्वेष्या या॥
verses.tr: daivīḥ ṣaḍurvīruru naḥ kṛṇota viśve devāsa iha mādayadhvam mā no vidadabhibhā mo aśastirmā no vidad vṛjinā dveṣyā yā
verses.en: Ye six divine Expanses, give us freedom. Here, all ye Gods, acquit yourselves like heroes. Let not calamity or curse o'ertake us, nor deeds of wickedness that merit hatred.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो देवीर्महि नः शर्म यछत प्रजायै नस्तन्वे३यच्च पुष्टम्।
मा हास्महि प्रजया मा तनूभिर्मा रधाम द्विषते सोम राजन्॥
verses.tr: tisro devīrmahi naḥ śarma yachata prajāyai nastanve3yacca puṣṭam mā hāsmahi prajayā mā tanūbhirmā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan
verses.en: Do ye three Goddesses give ample shelter and all success to us ourselves and children. Let as not lose our children or our bodies: let us not benefit the foe, King Soma!

verses.sa:
उरुव्यचा नो महिषः शर्म यछत्वस्मिन् हवे पुरुहूतः पुरुक्षु।
स नः प्रजायै हर्यश्व मृडेन्द्र मा नो रीरिषो मा परा दाः॥
verses.tr: uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yachatvasmin have puruhūtaḥ purukṣu sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḍendra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ
verses.en: Foodful and much-invoked, at this our calling may the far-reaching Bull grant us wide shelter. Lord of bay coursers, Indra, bless our children: harm us not, give us not as prey to others.

verses.sa:
धाता विधाता भुवनस्य यस्पतिर्देवः सविताभिमातिषाहः ।
आदित्या रुद्रा अश्विनोभा देवाः पान्तु यजमानं निरृथात्॥
verses.tr: dhātā vidhātā bhuvanasya yaspatirdevaḥ savitābhimātiṣāhaḥ ādityā rudrā aśvinobhā devāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nirṛthāt
verses.en: Lord of the world, Creator and Disposer, may the God Savitar who quells assailants, May the Adityas, Rudras, both the Asvins, Gods, guard the sacrificer from destruction. l

verses.sa:
ये नः सपत्ना अप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामह एनान्।
आदित्या रुद्रा उपरिस्पृशो न उग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रत॥
verses.tr: ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmaha enān ādityā rudrā uparispṛśo na ugraṃ cettāramadhirājamakrata
verses.en: Let those who are our foemen stay afar from us: with Indra and with Agni we will drive them off. The Adityas and the Rudras, over us on high, have made me strong, a thinker, and a sovran lord.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चमिन्द्रममुतो हवामहे यो गोजिद् धनजिदश्वजिद् यः ।
इमं नो यज्ञं विहवे शृणोत्वस्माकमभूर्हर्यश्व मेदी॥
verses.tr: arvāñcamindramamuto havāmahe yo gojid dhanajidaśvajid yaḥ imaṃ no yajñaṃ vihave śṛṇotvasmākamabhūrharyaśva medī
verses.en: Yea, we call Indra hitherward, the winner of wealth in battle and of kine and horses. May he mark this our worship when we call him Lord of bay steeds, thou art our friend and comrade.

sections.label: A charm against fever and other ailments
sections.name: Hymn 4

verses.sa:
यो गिरिष्वजायथा वीरुधां बलवत्तमः ।
कुष्ठेहि तक्मनाशन तक्मानं नाशयन्नितः॥
verses.tr: yo giriṣvajāyathā vīrudhāṃ balavattamaḥ kuṣṭhehi takmanāśana takmānaṃ nāśayannitaḥ
verses.en: Thou who wast born on mountains, thou most mighty of all plants that grow, Thou Banisher of Fever, come, Kushtha! make Fever pass away.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णसुवने गिरौ जातं हिमवतस्परि ।
धनैरभि श्रुत्वा यन्ति विदुर्हि तक्मनाशनम्॥
verses.tr: suparṇasuvane girau jātaṃ himavataspari dhanairabhi śrutvā yanti vidurhi takmanāśanam
verses.en: Brought from the Snowy Mountain, born on the high hill where eagles breed, Men seek to buy thee when they hear: for Fever's Banisher they know.

verses.sa:
अश्वत्थो देवसदनस्तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत॥
verses.tr: aśvattho devasadanastṛtīyasyāmito divi tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭhamavanvata
verses.en: In the third heaven above us stands the Asvattha tree, the seat of Gods. There the Gods sought the Kushtha Plant, embodiment of endless life.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययी नौरचरद्धिरण्यबन्धना दिवि।
तत्रामृतस्य पुष्पं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayī nauracaraddhiraṇyabandhanā divi tatrāmṛtasya puṣpaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭhamavanvata
verses.en: There moved through heaven a golden ship, a ship with cordage wrought of gold. There the Gods won the Kushtha Plant, the blossom of eternal life.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययाः पन्थान आसन्नरित्राणि हिरण्यया ।
नावो हिरण्ययीरासन् याभिः कुष्ठं निरावहन्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayāḥ panthāna āsannaritrāṇi hiraṇyayā nāvo hiraṇyayīrāsan yābhiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ nirāvahan
verses.en: They sailed on pathways paved with gold, the oars they piled were wrought of gold: All golden were the ships wherein they carried Kush-tha down to earth.

verses.sa:
इमं मे कुष्ठ पूरुषं तमा वह तं निष्कुरु ।
तमु मे अगदं कृधि॥
verses.tr: imaṃ me kuṣṭha pūruṣaṃ tamā vaha taṃ niṣkuru tamu me agadaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: O Kushtha, bring thou hitherward this man of mine, restore his health, Yea, free him from disease for me.

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यो अधि जातोऽसि सोमस्यासि सखा हितः ।
स प्राणाय व्यानाय चक्षुषे मे अस्मै मृड॥
verses.tr: devebhyo adhi jāto'si somasyāsi sakhā hitaḥ sa prāṇāya vyānāya cakṣuṣe me asmai mṛḍa
verses.en: Thou art descended from the Gods, Soma's benignant friend art thou. Befriend my breath and vital air, be gracious unto this mine eye.

verses.sa:
उदङ् जातो हिमवतः स प्राच्यां नीयसे जनम्।
तत्र कुष्ठस्य नामान्युत्तमानि वि भेजिरे॥
verses.tr: udaṅ jāto himavataḥ sa prācyāṃ nīyase janam tatra kuṣṭhasya nāmānyuttamāni vi bhejire
verses.en: Sprung, northward, from the Snowy Hill thou art conveyed to eastern men. There they deal out among themselves Kush ila's most noble qualities.

verses.sa:
उत्तमो नाम कुष्ठस्युत्तमो नाम ते पिता।
यक्ष्मं च सर्वं नाशय तक्मानं चारसं कृधि॥
verses.tr: uttamo nāma kuṣṭhasyuttamo nāma te pitā yakṣmaṃ ca sarvaṃ nāśaya takmānaṃ cārasaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Most excellent, indeed, art thou, Kushtha! most noble is thy sire. Make all Consumption pass away and render Fever powerless.

verses.sa:
शीर्षामयमुपहत्यामक्ष्योस्तन्वो३रपः ।
कुष्ठस्तत् सर्वं निष्करद् दैवं समह वृष्ण्यम्॥
verses.tr: śīrṣāmayamupahatyāmakṣyostanvo3rapaḥ kuṣṭhastat sarvaṃ niṣkarad daivaṃ samaha vṛṣṇyam
verses.en: Malady that affects the head, eye-weakness, bodily defect All this let Kushtha heal and cure: aye, godlike is the vigorous power.

sections.label: A charm to mend a broken bone
sections.name: Hymn 5

verses.sa:
रात्री माता नभः पितार्यमा ते पितामहः ।
सिलाची नाम वा असि सा देवानामसि स्वसा॥
verses.tr: rātrī mātā nabhaḥ pitāryamā te pitāmahaḥ silācī nāma vā asi sā devānāmasi svasā
verses.en: Aryaman is thy grandsire, Night thy mother, and the Cloud thy sire. Thy name is called Silachi, Thou, thyself, art sister of the Gods.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा पिबति जीवति त्रायसे पुरुषं त्वम्।
भर्त्री हि शश्वतामसि जनानां च न्यञ्चनी॥
verses.tr: yastvā pibati jīvati trāyase puruṣaṃ tvam bhartrī hi śaśvatāmasi janānāṃ ca nyañcanī
verses.en: Whoever drinketh thee hath life: thou savest and protectest man. As nursing mother of mankind, thou takest all upon thy lap.

verses.sa:
वृक्षंवृक्षमा रोहसि वृषण्यन्तीव कन्यला ।
जयन्ती प्रत्यातिष्ठन्ती स्परणी नाम वा असि॥
verses.tr: vṛkṣaṃvṛkṣamā rohasi vṛṣaṇyantīva kanyalā jayantī pratyātiṣṭhantī sparaṇī nāma vā asi
verses.en: Thou clingest close to every tree, as a fond damsel clasps her love. Thy name is called The Conqueror, She who Stands Fast, The Rescuer.

verses.sa:
यद् दण्डेन यदिष्वा यद् वारुर्हरसा कृतम्।
तस्य त्वमसि निष्कृतिः सेमं निष्कृधि पूरुषम्॥
verses.tr: yad daṇḍena yadiṣvā yad vārurharasā kṛtam tasya tvamasi niṣkṛtiḥ semaṃ niṣkṛdhi pūruṣam
verses.en: Whatever wound the arrow, or the staff, or violence inflicts, Thereof thou art the remedy: as such restore this man to health.

verses.sa:
भद्रात् प्लक्षान्निस्तिष्ठस्यश्वत्थात् खदिराद्धवात्।
भद्रान्न्यग्रोधात् पर्णात् सा न एह्यरुन्धति॥
verses.tr: bhadrāt plakṣānnistiṣṭhasyaśvatthāt khadirāddhavāt bhadrānnyagrodhāt parṇāt sā na ehyarundhati
verses.en: Thou springest from blest Plaxa, or Asvattha, Dhava, Khadira, Parna, or blest Nyagrodha, so come thou to us, Arundhati!

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णे सुभगे सूर्यवर्णे वपुष्टमे ।
रुतं गछासि निष्कृते निष्कृतिर्नाम वा असि॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyavarṇe subhage sūryavarṇe vapuṣṭame rutaṃ gachāsi niṣkṛte niṣkṛtirnāma vā asi
verses.en: Gold-coloured, bringing happy fate, most lovely, brilliant as the Sun, Mayst thou, O Healing! come unto the fracture: Healing is thy name.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णे सुभगे शुष्मे लोमशवक्षने ।
अपामसि स्वसा लाक्षे वातो हात्मा बभूव ते॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyavarṇe subhage śuṣme lomaśavakṣane apāmasi svasā lākṣe vāto hātmā babhūva te
verses.en: Gold-coloured, bringing happy fate, odorous, hairy-bodied one, The sister of the Waters art thou, Laksha! and a soul is Wind.

verses.sa:
सिलाची नाम कानीनोऽजबभ्रु पिता तव ।
अश्वो यमस्य यः श्यावस्तस्य हास्नास्युक्षिता॥
verses.tr: silācī nāma kānīno'jababhru pitā tava aśvo yamasya yaḥ śyāvastasya hāsnāsyukṣitā
verses.en: Silachi is thy name: thy sire, O goat-brown! is a damsel's son. Thou hast been sprinkled by the mouth of Yama tawny-coloured horse.

verses.sa:
अश्वस्यास्नः संपतिता सा वृक्षां अभि सिष्यदे ।
सरा पतत्रिणी भूत्वा सा न एह्यरुन्धति॥
verses.tr: aśvasyāsnaḥ saṃpatitā sā vṛkṣāṃ abhi siṣyade sarā patatriṇī bhūtvā sā na ehyarundhati
verses.en: Issuing from the horse's blood away she glided to the trees. Become a winged water-brook, and come to us, Arundhati!

sections.label: A prayer for protection and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 6

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद् वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः ।
स बुध्न्याऽ उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च वि वः॥
verses.tr: brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād vi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ sa budhnyā' upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vi vaḥ
verses.en: Eastward at first the prayer was generated: Vena disclosed bright flashes from the summit, Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of the non-existent and existent.

verses.sa:
अनाप्ता ये वः प्रथमा यानि कर्माणि चक्रिरे।
वीरान् नो अत्र मा दभन् तद् व एतत् पुरो दधे॥
verses.tr: anāptā ye vaḥ prathamā yāni karmāṇi cakrire vīrān no atra mā dabhan tad va etat puro dadhe
verses.en: None have attained to those of old, those who wrought holy acts for you, Let them not harm our heroes here. Therefore I set before you this.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधार एव ते समस्वरन् दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः ।
तस्य स्पशो न नि मिषन्ति भूर्णयः पदेपदे पाशिनः सन्ति सेतवे॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāra eva te samasvaran divo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ tasya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ padepade pāśinaḥ santi setave
verses.en: Sweet-tongued, exhaustless, they have sent their voices down together in heaven's vault that pours a thousand streams. His wildly-restless warders never close an eye: in every place the snarers stand to bind men fast.

verses.sa:
पर्यू षु प्र धन्वा वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः ।
द्विषस्तदध्यर्णवेनेयसे सनिस्रसो नामासि त्रयोदशो मास इन्द्रस्य गृहः॥
verses.tr: paryū ṣu pra dhanvā vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ dviṣastadadhyarṇaveneyase sanisraso nāmāsi trayodaśo māsa indrasya gṛhaḥ
verses.en: Speed forward, conquering all foes, to win the spoil. Thou comest on thy haters with a surging sea. Thy name is Fragile. The thirteenth month is Indra's home.

verses.sa:
न्वे३तेनारात्सीरसौ स्वाहा ।
तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृडतं नः॥
verses.tr: nve3tenārātsīrasau svāhā tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ
verses.en: Through this now hast thou sent thy gifts. All hail! With sharpened arms and missiles, kind and friendly, be gracious unto us, Soma and Rudra!

verses.sa:
अवैतेनारात्सीरसौ स्वाहा ।
तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृडतं नः॥
verses.tr: avaitenārātsīrasau svāhā tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ
verses.en: Through this hast thou been left in want. All hail! With sharpened arms and missiles, kind and friendly, be gracious unto us, Soma and Rudra!

verses.sa:
अपैतेनारात्सीरसौ स्वाहा ।
तिग्मायुधौ तिग्महेती सुशेवौ सोमारुद्राविह सु मृडतं नः॥
verses.tr: apaitenārātsīrasau svāhā tigmāyudhau tigmahetī suśevau somārudrāviha su mṛḍataṃ naḥ
verses.en: Through this hast thou committed faults. All hail! With sharpened arms and missiles, kind and friendly, be gracious unto us, Soma and Rudra!

verses.sa: मुमुक्तमस्मान् दुरितादवद्याज्जुषेथां यज्ञममृतमस्मासु धत्तम्॥
verses.tr: mumuktamasmān duritādavadyājjuṣethāṃ yajñamamṛtamasmāsu dhattam
verses.en: Free us from trouble, free us from dishonour, accept our worship, give us life immortal.

verses.sa:
चक्षुषो हेते मनसो हेते ब्रह्मणो हेते तपसश्च हेते ।
मेन्या मेनिरस्यमेनयस्ते सन्तु ये३स्माँ अभ्यघायन्ति॥
verses.tr: cakṣuṣo hete manaso hete brahmaṇo hete tapasaśca hete menyā menirasyamenayaste santu ye3smāṃ abhyaghāyanti
verses.en: O missile of the eye, missile of spirit, thou missile of devotion and of fervour! Thou art the weapon shot against the weapon. Let those be weaponless who sin against us.

verses.sa:
यो३ऽस्मांश्चक्षुषा मनसा चित्त्याकूत्या च यो अघायुरभिदासात्।
त्वं तानग्ने मेन्यामेनीन् कृणु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yo3'smāṃścakṣuṣā manasā cittyākūtyā ca yo aghāyurabhidāsāt tvaṃ tānagne menyāmenīn kṛṇu svāhā
verses.en: Make with thy weapon weaponless, O Agni, all wicked men who deal with us as foemen with eye, with thought, with spirit, or intention.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य गृहोऽसि । तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्र विशामि सर्वगुः
सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन्मेऽस्ति तेन॥
verses.tr: indrasya gṛho'si taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena
verses.en: Thou art the house of Indra. I betake me to thee, I enter thee with all my cattle, With all my people and with all my body, with all my soul, with mine entire possessions.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य शर्मासि ।तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्र विशामि सर्वगुः
सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन्मेऽस्ति तेन॥
verses.tr: indrasya śarmāsi taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā pra viśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena
verses.en: Thou art the guard of Indra. I betake me to thee, etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वर्मासि ।तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्रविशामि सर्वगुः
सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन्मेऽस्ति तेन॥
verses.tr: indrasya varmāsi taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā praviśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena
verses.en: Thou art the shield of Indra. I betake me to thee, etc.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वरूथमसि । तं त्वा प्र पद्ये तं त्वा प्रविशामि सर्वगुः
सर्वपूरुषः सर्वात्मा सर्वतनूः सह यन्मेऽस्ति तेन॥
verses.tr: indrasya varūthamasi taṃ tvā pra padye taṃ tvā praviśāmi sarvaguḥ sarvapūruṣaḥ sarvātmā sarvatanūḥ saha yanme'sti tena
verses.en: Indra's protection art thou. I betake me to thee, I enter thee with all my cattle, With all my people and with all my body, with all my soul, with mine entire possessions.

sections.label: A charm to deprecate Arati or Malignity
sections.name: Hymn 7

verses.sa:
आ नो भर मा परि ष्ठा अराते मा नो रक्षीर्दक्षिणां नीयमानाम्।
नमो वीर्त्साया असमृद्धये नमो अस्त्वरातये॥
verses.tr: ā no bhara mā pari ṣṭhā arāte mā no rakṣīrdakṣiṇāṃ nīyamānām namo vīrtsāyā asamṛddhaye namo astvarātaye
verses.en: Bring thou to us, bar not the way, Arati! t Stay not the guerdon that is being brought us. Homage be paid to Failure, to Misfortune, and Malignity.

verses.sa:
यमराते पुरोधत्से पुरुषं परिरापिणम्।
नमस्ते तस्मै कृण्मो मा वनिं व्यथयीर्मम॥
verses.tr: yamarāte purodhatse puruṣaṃ parirāpiṇam namaste tasmai kṛṇmo mā vaniṃ vyathayīrmama
verses.en: The man whom thou preferrest, O Arati, he who prates to us—This man of thine, we reverence. Baffle not thou my heart's desire.

verses.sa:
प्र णो वनिर्देवकृता दिवा नक्तं च कल्पताम्।
अरातिमनुप्रेमो वयं नमो अस्त्वरातये॥
verses.tr: pra ṇo vanirdevakṛtā divā naktaṃ ca kalpatām arātimanupremo vayaṃ namo astvarātaye
verses.en: May our desire which Gods have roused fulfil itself by day and night. We seek to win Arati: to Arati be our homage paid.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीमनुमतिं भगं यन्तो हवामहे ।
वाचं जुष्टां मधुमतीमवादिषं देवानां देवहूतिषु॥
verses.tr: sarasvatīmanumatiṃ bhagaṃ yanto havāmahe vācaṃ juṣṭāṃ madhumatīmavādiṣaṃ devānāṃ devahūtiṣu
verses.en: We, suppliant, call on Bhaga, on Sarasvati, Anumati. Pleasant words have I spoken, sweet as honey is, at invocations of the Gods.

verses.sa:
यं याचाम्यहं वाचा सरस्वत्या मनोयुजा ।
श्रद्धा तमद्य विन्दतु दत्ता सोमेन बभ्रुणा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ yācāmyahaṃ vācā sarasvatyā manoyujā śraddhā tamadya vindatu dattā somena babhruṇā
verses.en: The portion that I crave with speech intelligent and full of power, May faith, presented with the gift of tawny Soma, find to-day.

verses.sa:
मा वनिं मा वाचं नो वीर्त्सीरुभाविन्द्राग्नी आ भरतां नो वसूनि ।
सर्वे नो अद्य दित्सन्तोऽरातिं प्रति हर्यत॥
verses.tr: mā vaniṃ mā vācaṃ no vīrtsīrubhāvindrāgnī ā bharatāṃ no vasūni sarve no adya ditsanto'rātiṃ prati haryata
verses.en: Do not thou make our words or wishes fruitless. Let the twain, Indra Agni, bring us treasures. All, fain to-day to give us gifts, welcome Arati with your love.

verses.sa:
परोऽपेह्यसमृद्धे वि ते हेतिं नयामसि ।
वेद त्वाहं निमीवन्तीं नितुदन्तीमराते॥
verses.tr: paro'pehyasamṛddhe vi te hetiṃ nayāmasi veda tvāhaṃ nimīvantīṃ nitudantīmarāte
verses.en: Misfortune! go thou far away: we turn thy harmful dart aside, I know thee well, Arati! as oppressor, one who penetrates.

verses.sa:
उत नग्ना बोभुवती स्वप्नया सचसे जनम्।
अराते चित्तं वीर्त्सन्त्याकूतिं पुरुषस्य च॥
verses.tr: uta nagnā bobhuvatī svapnayā sacase janam arāte cittaṃ vīrtsantyākūtiṃ puruṣasya ca
verses.en: Oft, coming as a naked: girl thou hauntest people in their sleep, Baffling the thought, Arati! and the firm intention of a man.

verses.sa:
या महती महोन्माना विश्वा आशा व्यानशे।
तस्यै हिरण्यकेश्यै निरृत्या अकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: yā mahatī mahonmānā viśvā āśā vyānaśe tasyai hiraṇyakeśyai nirṛtyā akaraṃ namaḥ
verses.en: To her the mighty, vast in size, who penetrates all points of space, To her mine homage have I paid, Nirriti with her golden hair.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यवर्णा सुभगा हिरण्यकशिपुर्मही।
तस्यै हिरण्यद्रापयेऽरात्या अकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyavarṇā subhagā hiraṇyakaśipurmahī tasyai hiraṇyadrāpaye'rātyā akaraṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Auspicious, with her golden hue, pillowed on gold, the mighty one,—To this Arati clad in robes of gold mine homage have I paid.

sections.label: A charm for the discomfiture and destruction of hostile priests
sections.name: Hymn 8

verses.sa:
वैकङ्कतेनेध्मेन देवेभ्य आज्यं वह ।
अग्ने ताँ इह मादय सर्व आ यन्तु मे हवम्॥
verses.tr: vaikaṅkatenedhmena devebhya ājyaṃ vaha agne tāṃ iha mādaya sarva ā yantu me havam
verses.en: With fuel of Vikankata bring molten butter to the Gods. O Agni, make them joyful here: let them 'all come unto my call.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रा याहि मे हवमिदं करिष्यामि तच्छृणु ।
इम ऐन्द्रा अतिसरा आकूतिं सं नमन्तु मे ।
तेभिः शकेम वीर्यं१ जातवेदस्तनूवशिन्॥
verses.tr: indrā yāhi me havamidaṃ kariṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ima aindrā atisarā ākūtiṃ saṃ namantu me tebhiḥ śakema vīryaṃ1 jātavedastanūvaśin
verses.en: O Indra, come unto my call. This will I do. So hear it thou. Let thee exertions for the sake of Indra guide my wish aright. Therewith, O Jatavedas, Lord of Bodies! may we win us strength.

verses.sa:
यदसावमुतो देवा अदेवः संश्चिकीर्षति ।
मा तस्याग्निर्हव्यं वाक्षीद्धवं देवा अस्य मोप गुर्ममैव हवमेतन॥
verses.tr: yadasāvamuto devā adevaḥ saṃścikīrṣati mā tasyāgnirhavyaṃ vākṣīddhavaṃ devā asya mopa gurmamaiva havametana
verses.en: Whatever plot from yonder, Oye Gods, that godless man would frame, Let not the Gods come to his call, nor Agni bear his offering up. Come ye, come hither to my call.

verses.sa:
अति धावतातिसरा इन्द्रस्य वचसा हत ।
अविं वृक इव मथ्नीत स वो जीवन्मा मोचि प्राणमस्यापि नह्यत॥
verses.tr: ati dhāvatātisarā indrasya vacasā hata aviṃ vṛka iva mathnīta sa vo jīvanmā moci prāṇamasyāpi nahyata
verses.en: Run, ye Exertions, farther on. By Indra's order smite and slay. Asa wolf worketh a sheep, so let not him escape from you while life remains. Stop fast his breath.

verses.sa:
यममी पुरोदधिरे ब्रह्माणमपभूतये ।
इन्द्र स ते अधस्पदं तं प्रत्यस्यामि मृत्यवे॥
verses.tr: yamamī purodadhire brahmāṇamapabhūtaye indra sa te adhaspadaṃ taṃ pratyasyāmi mṛtyave
verses.en: The Brahman whom those yonder have appointed priest, for injury, He, Indra! is beneath thy feet. I cast him to the God of Death. f

verses.sa:
यदि प्रेयुर्देवपुरा ब्रह्म वर्माणि चक्रिरे।
तनूपानं परिपाणं कृण्वाना यदुपोचिरे सर्वं तदरसं कृधि॥
verses.tr: yadi preyurdevapurā brahma varmāṇi cakrire tanūpānaṃ paripāṇaṃ kṛṇvānā yadupocire sarvaṃ tadarasaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: If they have issued forth, strongholds of Gods, and made their shield of prayer, Gaining protection for their lives, protection round about, make all their instigation powerless.

verses.sa:
यानसावतिसरांश्चकार कृणवच्च यान्।
त्वं तानिन्द्र वृत्रहन् प्रतीचः पुनरा कृधि यथामुं तृणहां जनम्॥
verses.tr: yānasāvatisarāṃścakāra kṛṇavacca yān tvaṃ tānindra vṛtrahan pratīcaḥ punarā kṛdhi yathāmuṃ tṛṇahāṃ janam
verses.en: Exertions which that man hath made, Exertions which he yet will make—Turn them, O Indra, back again, O Vritra-slayer, back again on him that they may kill that man.

verses.sa:
यथेन्द्र उद्वाचनं लब्ध्वा चक्रे अधस्पदम्।
कृण्वे३ऽहमधरांस्तथामूञ्छश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: yathendra udvācanaṃ labdhvā cakre adhaspadam kṛṇve3'hamadharāṃstathāmūñchaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ
verses.en: As Indra, having seized him, set his foot upon Udvachana, Even so for all the coming years I cast those men beneath my feet.

verses.sa:
अत्रैनानिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नुग्रो मर्मणि विध्य ।
अत्रैवैनानभि तिष्ठेन्द्र मेद्य१हं तव ।
अनु त्वेन्द्रा रभामहे स्याम सुमतौ तव॥
verses.tr: atrainānindra vṛtrahannugro marmaṇi vidhya atraivainānabhi tiṣṭhendra medya1haṃ tava anu tvendrā rabhāmahe syāma sumatau tava
verses.en: Here, Indra Vritra-slayer, in thy strength pierce thou their vital parts. Here, even here, attack them, O Indra. Thine own dear friend am I. Indra, we closely cling to thee. May we be in thy favouring grace.

sections.label: A prayer to Heaven and Earth for protection and assistance
sections.name: Hymn 9

verses.sa: दिवे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dive svāhā
verses.en: All hail to Heaven! J

verses.sa: पृथिव्यै स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pṛthivyai svāhā
verses.en: All hail to Earth! J

verses.sa: अन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: antarikṣāya svāhā
verses.en: All hail to Air!

verses.sa: अन्तरिक्षाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: antarikṣāya svāhā
verses.en: All hail to Air!

verses.sa: दिवेस्वाहा॥
verses.tr: divesvāhā
verses.en: All hail to Heaven!

verses.sa: पृथिव्यै स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pṛthivyai svāhā
verses.en: All hail to Earth!

verses.sa:
सूर्यो मे चक्षुर्वातः प्राणो३न्तरिक्षमात्मा पृथिवी शरीरम्।
अस्तृतो नामाहमय मस्मि स आत्मानं नि दधे द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां गोपीथाय॥
verses.tr: sūryo me cakṣurvātaḥ prāṇo3ntarikṣamātmā pṛthivī śarīram astṛto nāmāhamaya masmi sa ātmānaṃ ni dadhe dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ gopīthāya
verses.en: Mine eye is Sarya and my breath is Vata, Air is my soul and Prithivi my body. I verily who never have been conquered give up. my life to Heaven and Earth for keeping.

verses.sa:
उदायुरुद् बलमुत् कृतमुत् कृत्यामुन्मनीषामुदिन्द्रियम्।
आयुष्कृदायुष्पत्नी स्वधावन्तौ गोपा मे स्तं गोपायतं मा ।
आत्मसदौ मे स्तं मा हिंसिष्टम्॥
verses.tr: udāyurud balamut kṛtamut kṛtyāmunmanīṣāmudindriyam āyuṣkṛdāyuṣpatnī svadhāvantau gopā me staṃ gopāyataṃ mā ātmasadau me staṃ mā hiṃsiṣṭam
verses.en: Exalt my life, my strength, my deed and action; increase my understanding and my vigour. Be ye my powerful keepers, watch and guard me, ye mistresses of life and life's creators! Dwell ye within me, and forbear to harm me.

sections.label: A prayer to the presiding deities of the four quarters for protection
sections.name: Hymn 10

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा प्राच्या दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत् स ऋच्छात्॥
verses.tr: aśmavarma me'si yo mā prācyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt etat sa ṛcchāt
verses.en: Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the eastern quarter. May he encounter it!

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा दक्षिणाया दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत् स ऋच्छात्॥
verses.tr: aśmavarma me'si yo mā dakṣiṇāyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt etat sa ṛcchāt
verses.en: Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the southern quarter. May he encounter it!

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा प्रतीच्या दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत् स ऋच्छात्॥
verses.tr: aśmavarma me'si yo mā pratīcyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt etat sa ṛcchāt
verses.en: Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the western quarter. May he encounter it!

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मोदीच्या दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत् स ऋच्छात्॥
verses.tr: aśmavarma me'si yo modīcyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt etat sa ṛcchāt
verses.en: Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the northern quarter. May he encounter it!

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा ध्रुवाया दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत् स ऋच्छात्॥
verses.tr: aśmavarma me'si yo mā dhruvāyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt etat sa ṛcchāt
verses.en: Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the stedfast region. May he encounter it!

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मोर्ध्वाया दिशोऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत् स ऋच्छात्॥
verses.tr: aśmavarma me'si yo mordhvāyā diśo'ghāyurabhidāsāt etat sa ṛcchāt
verses.en: Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who fights against me from the lofty region! May he encounter it!

verses.sa:
अश्मवर्म मेऽसि यो मा दिशामन्तर्देशेभ्योऽघायुरभिदासात्।
एतत् स ऋच्छात्॥
verses.tr: aśmavarma me'si yo mā diśāmantardeśebhyo'ghāyurabhidāsāt etat sa ṛcchāt
verses.en: Thou art my wall of stone against the sinner who from points intermediate fights against me. May he encounter it!

verses.sa:
बृहता मन उप ह्वये मातरिश्वना प्राणापानौ।
सूर्याच्चक्षुरन्तरिक्षाच्छ्रोत्रं पृथिव्याः शरीरम्।
सरस्वत्या वाचमुप ह्वयामहे मनोयुजा॥
verses.tr: bṛhatā mana upa hvaye mātariśvanā prāṇāpānau sūryāccakṣurantarikṣācchrotraṃ pṛthivyāḥ śarīram sarasvatyā vācamupa hvayāmahe manoyujā
verses.en: With Brihat I invoke the mind, with Matarisvan both the breath? The eye from Surya, and the ear from Air, the body from the Earth. We, with Sarasvati who suits the mind, call Speech to come to us.

sections.label: A dialogue between Atharvan and Varuna
sections.name: Hymn 11

verses.sa:
कथं महे असुरायाब्रवीरिह कथं पित्रे हरये त्वेषनृम्णः ।
पृश्निं वरुण दक्षिणां ददावान् पुनर्मघ त्वं मनसाचिकित्सीः॥
verses.tr: kathaṃ mahe asurāyābravīriha kathaṃ pitre haraye tveṣanṛmṇaḥ pṛśniṃ varuṇa dakṣiṇāṃ dadāvān punarmagha tvaṃ manasācikitsīḥ
verses.en: How, terrible in might, hast thou here spoken to the great God, how to the gold-hued Father? Thy mind watched, greedy Varuna! to recover the brindled cow thou hadst bestowed as guerdon. Stedfast region: the nadir. G Lofty region: the zenith.

verses.sa:
न कामेन पुनर्मघो भवामि सं चक्षे कं पृश्निमेतामुपाजे ।
केन नु त्वमथर्वन् काव्येन केन जातेनासि जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: na kāmena punarmagho bhavāmi saṃ cakṣe kaṃ pṛśnimetāmupāje kena nu tvamatharvan kāvyena kena jātenāsi jātavedāḥ
verses.en: Not through desire do I revoke my present: I bring this brindled cow to contemplate her. Now by what lore, by what inherent nature, knowest thou all things that exist, Atharvan?

verses.sa:
सत्यमहं गभीरः काव्येन सत्यं जातेनास्मि जातवेदाः ।
न मे दासो नार्यो महित्वा व्रतं मीमाय यदहं धरिष्ये॥
verses.tr: satyamahaṃ gabhīraḥ kāvyena satyaṃ jātenāsmi jātavedāḥ na me dāso nāryo mahitvā vrataṃ mīmāya yadahaṃ dhariṣye
verses.en: Truly I am profound in wisdom, truly I know by nature all existing creatures. No Dasa by his greatness, not an Arya, may violate the law that I will stablish. l

verses.sa:
न त्वदन्यः कवितरो न मेधया धीरतरो वरुण स्वधावन्।
त्वं ता विश्वा भुवनानि वेत्थ स चिन्नु त्वज्जनो मायी बिभाय॥
verses.tr: na tvadanyaḥ kavitaro na medhayā dhīrataro varuṇa svadhāvan tvaṃ tā viśvā bhuvanāni vettha sa cinnu tvajjano māyī bibhāya
verses.en: None, self-dependent -Varuna! existeth wiser than thou or sager by his wisdom. "Thou knowest well all these created beings: even the man of wondrous powers fears thee.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्य१ङ्ग वरुण स्वधावन् विश्वा वेत्थ जनिम सुप्रणीते ।
किं रजस एना परो अन्यदस्त्येना किं परेणावरममुर॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hya1ṅga varuṇa svadhāvan viśvā vettha janima supraṇīte kiṃ rajasa enā paro anyadastyenā kiṃ pareṇāvaramamura
verses.en: O self-dependent Varuna, wise director, thou knowest verily all generations. What is, unerring one! f beyond this region? What more remote than that which is most distant?

verses.sa:
एकं रजस एना परो अन्यदस्त्येना पर एकेन दुर्णशं चिदर्वाक्।
तत् ते विद्वान् वरुण प्र ब्रवीम्यधोवचसः पणयो भवन्तु नीचैर्दासा उप सर्पन्तु भूमिम्॥
verses.tr: ekaṃ rajasa enā paro anyadastyenā para ekena durṇaśaṃ cidarvāk tat te vidvān varuṇa pra bravīmyadhovacasaḥ paṇayo bhavantu nīcairdāsā upa sarpantu bhūmim
verses.en: One thing there is beyond this air, and something beyond that one, most hard to reach, remotest. I, Varuna, who know, to thee declare it. Let churls be mighty in the lower regions. Let Dasas sink into the earth beneath them.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्य१ङ्ग वरुण ब्रवीषि पुनर्मघेष्ववद्यानि भूरि ।
मो षु पणींरभ्ये३तावतो भून्मा त्वा वोचन्नराधसं जनासः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hya1ṅga varuṇa bravīṣi punarmagheṣvavadyāni bhūri mo ṣu paṇīṃrabhye3tāvato bhūnmā tvā vocannarādhasaṃ janāsaḥ
verses.en: Many reproaches, Varuna, dost thou utter against the misers who revoke their presents. Be not thou added to that crowd of niggards: let not men call thee an illiberal giver.

verses.sa:
मा मा वोचन्नराधसं जनासः पुनस्ते पृश्निं जरितर्ददामि ।
स्तोत्रं मे विश्वमा याहि शचीभिरन्तर्विश्वासु मानुषीषु दिक्षु॥
verses.tr: mā mā vocannarādhasaṃ janāsaḥ punaste pṛśniṃ jaritardadāmi stotraṃ me viśvamā yāhi śacībhirantarviśvāsu mānuṣīṣu dikṣu
verses.en: Let not men call me an illiberal giver. I give thee back the brindled cow, O singer. Attend, in every place where men inhabit, with all thy powers, the hymn that tells my praises.

verses.sa:
आ ते स्तोत्राण्युद्यतानि यन्त्वन्तर्विश्वासु मानुषीषु दिक्षु।
देहि नु मे यन्मे अदत्तो असि युज्यो मे सप्तपदः सखासि॥
verses.tr: ā te stotrāṇyudyatāni yantvantarviśvāsu mānuṣīṣu dikṣu dehi nu me yanme adatto asi yujyo me saptapadaḥ sakhāsi
verses.en: Let hymns of praise ascend to thee, uplifted in every place of human habitation. But give me now the gift thou hast not given. Thou art my friend for ever firm and faithful.

verses.sa:
समा नौ बन्धुर्वरुण समा जा वेदाहं तद् यन्नावेषा समा जा।
ददामि तद् यत् ते अदत्तो अस्मि युज्यस्ते सप्तपदः सखास्मि॥
verses.tr: samā nau bandhurvaruṇa samā jā vedāhaṃ tad yannāveṣā samā jā dadāmi tad yat te adatto asmi yujyaste saptapadaḥ sakhāsmi
verses.en: One origin, Varuna! one bond unites us: I know the nature of that common kinship. I give thee now the gift that I retracted. I am thy friend for ever firm and faithful.

verses.sa:
देवो देवाय गृणते वयोधा विप्रो विप्राय स्तुवते सुमेधाः ।
अजीजनो हि वरुण स्वधावन्नथर्वाणं पितरं देवबन्धुम्।
तस्मा उ राधः कृणुहि सुप्रशस्तं सखा नो असि परमं च बन्धुः॥
verses.tr: devo devāya gṛṇate vayodhā vipro viprāya stuvate sumedhāḥ ajījano hi varuṇa svadhāvannatharvāṇaṃ pitaraṃ devabandhum tasmā u rādhaḥ kṛṇuhi supraśastaṃ sakhā no asi paramaṃ ca bandhuḥ
verses.en: God, giving life unto the god who lauds me, Sage strengthener of the sage who sings my praises. Thou, self-dependent Varuna! hast begotten the kinsman of the Gods, our sire Atharvan. On him bestow most highly-lauded riches. Thou art our friend, high over all, our kinsman.

sections.label: An Apri or Propitiatory Hymn
sections.name: Hymn 12

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अद्य मनुषो दुरोणे देवो देवान् यजसि जातवेदः ।
आ च वह मित्रमहश्चिकित्वान्त्वं दूतः कविरसि प्रचेताः॥
verses.tr: samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ
verses.en: Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods as God, O Jatavedas. Observant, bright as Mitra, bring them hither. Thou art a sapient and foreknowing envoy.

verses.sa:
तनूनपात् पथ ऋतस्य यानान् मध्वा समञ्जन्त्स्वदया सुजिह्व ।
मन्मानि धीभिरुत यज्ञमृन्धन् देवत्रा च कृणुह्यध्वरं नः॥
verses.tr: tanūnapāt patha ṛtasya yānān madhvā samañjantsvadayā sujihva manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ naḥ
verses.en: Tanunapat, fair-tongued! with sweet meath balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant. Bear to the Gods our sacrifice, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.

verses.sa:
आजुह्वान ईड्यो बन्द्यश्चा याह्यग्ने वसुभिः सजोषाः ।
त्वं देवानामसि यह्व होता स एनान् यक्षीषितो यजीयान्॥
verses.tr: ājuhvāna īḍyo bandyaścā yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enān yakṣīṣito yajīyān
verses.en: Invoked, deserving prayer and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus. Thou art, O youthful Lord, the Gods' Invoker, so, best of sacrificers, bring them quickly.

verses.sa:
प्राचीनं बर्हिः प्रदिशा पृथिव्या वस्तोरस्या वृज्यते अग्रे अह्नाम्।
व्युऽप्रथते वितरं वरीयो देवेभ्यो अदितये स्योनम्॥
verses.tr: prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agre ahnām vyu'prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam
verses.en: By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe this earth when dawns are breaking. Widely it spreads around and far extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.

verses.sa:
व्यचस्वतीरुर्विया वि श्रयन्तां पतिभ्यो न जनयः शुम्भमानाः ।
देवीर्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा देवेभ्यो भवत सुप्रायणाः॥
verses.tr: vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ
verses.en: Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands. Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy entrance!

verses.sa:
आ सुष्वयन्ती यजते उपाके उषासानक्ता सदतां नि योनौ ।
दिव्ये योषणे बृहती सुरुक्मे अधि श्रियं शुक्रपिशं दधाने॥
verses.tr: ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne
verses.en: Pouring sweet dews let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, be seated at their station,—Lofty, celestial Dames with gold to deck them, assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा सुवाचा मिमाना यज्ञं मनुषो यजध्यै ।
प्रचोदयन्ता विदथेषु कारू प्राचीनं ज्योतिः प्रदिशा दिशन्ता॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā
verses.en: Come the first two celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastern light with their direction!

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञं भारती तूयमेत्विडा मनुष्वदिह चेतयन्ती ।
तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं स्योनं सरस्वतीः स्वपसः सदन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḍā manuṣvadiha cetayantī tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatīḥ svapasaḥ sadantām
verses.en: Let Bharati come quickly to our worship and lid showing like a human being. So let Sarasvati and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.

verses.sa:
य इमे द्यावापृथिवी जनित्री रूपैरपिंशद् भुवनानि विश्वा ।
तमद्य होतरिषितो यजीयान् देवं त्वष्टारमिहयक्षि विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiṃśad bhuvanāni viśvā tamadya hotariṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāramihayakṣi vidvān
verses.en: Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed to-day God Tvashtar, thou who knowest, Even him who formed these two, the Earth and Heaven, the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.

verses.sa:
उपावसृज त्मन्या समञ्जन् देवानां पाथ ऋतुथा हवींषि ।
वनस्पतिः शमिता देवो अग्निः स्वदन्तु हव्यं मधुना घृतेन॥
verses.tr: upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena
verses.en: Bring thou to our oblations which thou balmest the companies of Gods in ordered season. Agni, Vanaspati, the Immolator sweeten our offered gifts with meath and butter!

verses.sa:
सद्यो जातो व्यऽमिमीत यज्ञमग्निर्देवानामभवत् पुरोगाः ।
अस्य होतुः प्रशिष्यृतस्य वाचि स्वाहाकृतं हविरदन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: sadyo jāto vya'mimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavat purogāḥ asya hotuḥ praśiṣyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ
verses.en: I Agni as soon as he was born made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods' preceder. May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to this true Priest's voice and guidance.

sections.label: A charm against snakes
sections.name: Hymn 13

verses.sa:
ददिर्हि मह्यं वरुणो दिवः कविर्वचोभिरुग्रैर्नि रिणामि ते विषम्।
खातमखातमुत सक्तमग्रभमिरेव धन्वन् नि जजास ते विषम्॥
verses.tr: dadirhi mahyaṃ varuṇo divaḥ kavirvacobhirugrairni riṇāmi te viṣam khātamakhātamuta saktamagrabhamireva dhanvan ni jajāsa te viṣam
verses.en: Varuna, Sage of heaven, hath given me the gift: with spells of mighty power I draw thy poison out. Dug up, not dug, adherent, I have seized it fast: low hath thy venom sunk like water in the sands.

verses.sa:
यत् ते अपोदकं विषं तत् त एतास्वग्रभम्।
गृह्णामि ते मध्यममुत्तमं रसमुतावमं भियसा नेशदादु ते॥
verses.tr: yat te apodakaṃ viṣaṃ tat ta etāsvagrabham gṛhṇāmi te madhyamamuttamaṃ rasamutāvamaṃ bhiyasā neśadādu te
verses.en: All the non-fluid portion of thy venom, I receive in these. I take thy middlemost, thy highest, lowest juice: may it be spent and lost by reason of thy fear.

verses.sa:
वृषा मे रवो नभसा न तन्यतुरुग्रेण ते वचसा बाध आदु ते ।
अहं तमस्य नृभिरग्रभं रसं तमस इव ज्योतिरुदेतु सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā me ravo nabhasā na tanyaturugreṇa te vacasā bādha ādu te ahaṃ tamasya nṛbhiragrabhaṃ rasaṃ tamasa iva jyotirudetu sūryaḥ
verses.en: Strong is my cry like thunder with the rainy cloud: with powerful incantation let thy strength. be stayed. I, with the men to aid, have seized that juice of his; as light from out the gloom, let Surya rise on high.

verses.sa:
चक्षुषा ते चक्षुर्हन्मि विषेण हन्मि ते विषम्।
अहे म्रियस्व मा जीवीः प्रत्यगभ्येऽतु त्वा विषम्॥
verses.tr: cakṣuṣā te cakṣurhanmi viṣeṇa hanmi te viṣam ahe mriyasva mā jīvīḥ pratyagabhye'tu tvā viṣam
verses.en: I with this eye destroy thine eye, and with this poison conquer thine. Live not, O Snake, but die the death: back go thy venom on thyself.

verses.sa:
कैरात पृश्न उपतृण्य बभ्र आ मे शृणुतासिता अलीकाः ।
मा मे सख्युः स्तामानमपि ष्ठाताश्रावयन्तो नि विषे रमध्वम्॥
verses.tr: kairāta pṛśna upatṛṇya babhra ā me śṛṇutāsitā alīkāḥ mā me sakhyuḥ stāmānamapi ṣṭhātāśrāvayanto ni viṣe ramadhvam
verses.en: Listen to me, Black Snakes and hateful creatures, Lurker-in-grass, Karait, and Brown, and Spotty, Approach not near the house my friend inhabits: give warning, and rest quiet with your poison.

verses.sa:
असितस्य तैमातस्य बभ्रोरपोदकस्य च ।
सात्रासाहस्याहं मन्योरव ज्यामिव धन्वनो वि मुञ्चामि रथाँ इव॥
verses.tr: asitasya taimātasya babhrorapodakasya ca sātrāsāhasyāhaṃ manyorava jyāmiva dhanvano vi muñcāmi rathāṃ iva
verses.en: Even as the cord that strings the bow, I slacken, a it were, the cars Of the All-conquering serpent's wrath, of the fierce rage of Black, and Brown, Taimata, and Apodaka,

verses.sa:
आलिगी च विलिगी च पिता च माता च ।
विद्म वः सर्वतो बन्ध्वरसाः किं करिष्यथ॥
verses.tr: āligī ca viligī ca pitā ca mātā ca vidma vaḥ sarvato bandhvarasāḥ kiṃ kariṣyatha
verses.en: And Aligi and Vilipti, their father and the mother What will ye do? Your venomed sap, we know, is utterly powerless.

verses.sa:
उरुगूलाया दुहिता जाता दास्यसिक्न्या ।
प्रतङ्कं दद्रुषीणां सर्वासामरसं विषम्॥
verses.tr: urugūlāyā duhitā jātā dāsyasiknyā prataṅkaṃ dadruṣīṇāṃ sarvāsāmarasaṃ viṣam
verses.en: Daughter of Urugula, she-fiend whom the black-skinned mother bare All female serpents' poison who crept swiftly near is impotent.

verses.sa:
कर्णा श्वावित् तदब्रवीद् गिरेरवचरन्तिका।
याः काश्चेमाः खनित्रिमास्तासामरसतमं विषम्॥
verses.tr: karṇā śvāvit tadabravīd gireravacarantikā yāḥ kāścemāḥ khanitrimāstāsāmarasatamaṃ viṣam
verses.en: Dwelling beside the mountain's slope, the quick-eared porcupine exclaimed: Of all these she-snakes homed in earth the poison is most powerless.

verses.sa:
ताबुवं न ताबुवं न घेत् त्वमसि ताबुवम्।
ताबुवेनारसं विषम्॥
तस्तुवं न तस्तुवं न घेत् त्वमसि तस्तुवम्।
तस्तुवेनारसं विषम्॥
verses.tr: tābuvaṃ na tābuvaṃ na ghet tvamasi tābuvam tābuvenārasaṃ viṣam tastuvaṃ na tastuvaṃ na ghet tvamasi tastuvam tastuvenārasaṃ viṣam
verses.en: Tabuva or not Tabuva, thou verily art not Tabuva: poison is killed by Tabuva. Tastuva or not Tastuva, thou verily art not Tastuva: j poison is killed by Tastuva.

sections.label: A charm against witchcraft
sections.name: Hymn 14

verses.sa:
सुपर्णस्त्वान्वविन्दत् सूकरस्त्वाखन्नसा।
दिप्सौषधे त्वं दिप्सन्तमव कृत्याकृतं जहि॥
verses.tr: suparṇastvānvavindat sūkarastvākhannasā dipsauṣadhe tvaṃ dipsantamava kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi
verses.en: An Vedi found thee: with his snout a wild boar dug thee from the earth. Harm thou, O Plant, the mischievous, and drive the Sorcerer away.

verses.sa:
अव जहि यातुधानानव कृत्याकृतं जहि ।
अथो योअस्मान् दिप्सति तमु त्वं जह्योषधे॥
verses.tr: ava jahi yātudhānānava kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi atho yoasmān dipsati tamu tvaṃ jahyoṣadhe
verses.en: Beat thou the Yatudhanas back, drive thou away the sorcerer; And chase afar, O Plant, the man who fain would do us injury.

verses.sa:
रिश्यस्येव परीशासं परिकृत्य परि त्वचः ।
कृत्यां कृत्याकृते देवा निष्कमिव प्रति मुञ्चत॥
verses.tr: riśyasyeva parīśāsaṃ parikṛtya pari tvacaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte devā niṣkamiva prati muñcata
verses.en: As 'twere a strip cut round from skin of a white footed antelope, Bind, like a golden chain, O God, his witchcraft on l the sorcerer.

verses.sa:
पुनः कृत्यां कृत्याकृते हस्तगृह्य परा णय ।
समक्षमस्मा आ धेहि यथा कृत्याकृतं हनत्॥
verses.tr: punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte hastagṛhya parā ṇaya samakṣamasmā ā dhehi yathā kṛtyākṛtaṃ hanat
verses.en: Take thou his sorcery by the hand, and to the sorcerer lead it back. Lay it before him, face to face, that it may kill the sorcerer.

verses.sa:
कृत्याः सन्तु कृत्याकृते शपथः शपथीयते।
सुखो रथ इव वर्ततां कृत्या कृत्याकृतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: kṛtyāḥ santu kṛtyākṛte śapathaḥ śapathīyate sukho ratha iva vartatāṃ kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: Back on the wizard fall his craft, upon the curser light his curse! Let witchcraft, like a well-naved car, roll back upon the sorcerer.

verses.sa:
यदि स्त्री यदि वा पुमान् कृत्यां चकार पाप्मने ।
तामु तस्मै नयामस्यश्वमिवाश्वाभिधान्या॥
verses.tr: yadi strī yadi vā pumān kṛtyāṃ cakāra pāpmane tāmu tasmai nayāmasyaśvamivāśvābhidhānyā
verses.en: Whoso, for other's harm hath dealt—woman or man—in magic arts, To him we lead the sorcery back, even as a courser with a rope.

verses.sa:
यदि वासि देवकृता यदि वा पुरुषैः कृता।
तां त्वा पुनर्णयामसीन्द्रेण सयुजा वयम्॥
verses.tr: yadi vāsi devakṛtā yadi vā puruṣaiḥ kṛtā tāṃ tvā punarṇayāmasīndreṇa sayujā vayam
verses.en: Now whether thou hast been prepared by Gods or been prepared by men, We, with our Indra at our side to aid us, lead thee back again.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पृतनाषाट् पृतनाः सहस्व ।
पुनः कृत्यां कृत्याकृते प्रतिहरणेन हरामसि॥
verses.tr: agne pṛtanāṣāṭ pṛtanāḥ sahasva punaḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtyākṛte pratiharaṇena harāmasi
verses.en: Agni, victorious in fight, subdue the armies of our foes! Back on the sorcerer we cast his sorcery, and beat it home.

verses.sa:
कृतव्यधनि विध्य तं यश्चकार तमिज्जहि ।
न त्वामचक्रुषे वयं वधाय सं शिशीमहि॥
verses.tr: kṛtavyadhani vidhya taṃ yaścakāra tamijjahi na tvāmacakruṣe vayaṃ vadhāya saṃ śiśīmahi
verses.en: Thou who hast piercing weapons, pierce him who hath wrought it; conquer him. We do not sharpen thee to slay the man who hath not practised it.

verses.sa:
पुत्र इव पितरं गच्छ स्वज इवाभिष्ठितो दश ।
बन्धमिवावक्रामी गच्छ कृत्ये कृत्याकृतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: putra iva pitaraṃ gaccha svaja ivābhiṣṭhito daśa bandhamivāvakrāmī gaccha kṛtye kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: Go as a son goes to his sire: bite as a trampled viper bites. As one who flies from bonds, go back, O Witchcraft to the sorcerer.

verses.sa:
उदेणीव वारण्यऽभिस्कन्दं मृगीव ।
कृत्या कर्तारमृच्छतु॥
verses.tr: udeṇīva vāraṇya'bhiskandaṃ mṛgīva kṛtyā kartāramṛcchatu
verses.en: Even as the timid antelope or hind from her assailant flees, So swiftly let the sorcery overtake and reach the sorcerer.

verses.sa:
इष्वा ऋजीयः पततु द्यावापृथिवी तं प्रति ।
सा तं मृगमिव गृह्णतु कृत्या कृत्याकृतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: iṣvā ṛjīyaḥ patatu dyāvāpṛthivī taṃ prati sā taṃ mṛgamiva gṛhṇatu kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: Straighter than any arrow let it fly against him, Heaven and Earth! So let that witchcraft seize again the wizard like a beast of chase.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिवैतु प्रतिकूलमनुकूलमिवोदकम्।
सुखो रथ इव वर्ततां कृत्या कृत्याकृतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: agnirivaitu pratikūlamanukūlamivodakam sukho ratha iva vartatāṃ kṛtyā kṛtyākṛtaṃ punaḥ
verses.en: Let it go contrary like flame, like water following its course. Let witchcraft, like a well-naved car, roll back upon the sorcerer.

sections.label: A charm for general prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 15

verses.sa:
एका च मे दश च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
verses.tr: ekā ca me daśa ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ
verses.en: Plant! I have those who shall avert the threatened danger, ten and one. O sacred Plant, produced aright! make sweetness, sweet thyself, for me.

verses.sa:
द्वे च मे विंशतिश्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
verses.tr: dve ca me viṃśatiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ
verses.en: Twenty and two, O Plant, have I who shall avert the threatened ill. O sacred Plant, produced aright! make sweetness, sweet thyself, for me.

verses.sa:
तिस्रश्च मे त्रिंशच्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
चतस्रश्च मे चत्वारिंशच्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
पञ्च च मे पञ्चाशच्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
षट् च मे षष्टिश्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
सप्त च मे सप्ततिश्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
अष्ट च मेऽशीतिश्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
नव च मे नवतिश्च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
दश च मे शतं च मे ऽपवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
शतं च मे सहस्रं चापवक्तार ओषधे ।
ऋतजात ऋतावरि मधु मे मधुला करः॥
verses.tr: tisraśca me triṃśacca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ catasraśca me catvāriṃśacca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ pañca ca me pañcāśacca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ ṣaṭ ca me ṣaṣṭiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ sapta ca me saptatiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ aṣṭa ca me'śītiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ nava ca me navatiśca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ daśa ca me śataṃ ca me 'pavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ śataṃ ca me sahasraṃ cāpavaktāra oṣadhe ṛtajāta ṛtāvari madhu me madhulā karaḥ
verses.en: [Griffith: 'Stanzas 3-11 of the hymn, which is a charm for general prosperity, are exactly the same with the exception of the numbers which increase by eleven in each stanza (thirty and three, forty and four, and so on) up to one hundred and ten in stanza 10, stanza 11 concluding with one thousand and one hundred.']

sections.label: A charm for the increase of cattle
sections.name: Hymn 16

verses.sa: यद्येकवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
verses.tr: yadyekavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si
verses.en: Bull! if thou art the single bull, beget. Thou hast no vital sap.

verses.sa:
यदि द्विवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यदि त्रिवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यदि चतुर्वृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यदि पञ्चवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यदि षड्-वृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यदि सप्तवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यद्यष्टवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यदि नववृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यदि दशवृषोऽसि सृजारसोऽसि॥
यद्येकादशोऽसि सोऽपोदको ऽसि॥
verses.tr: yadi dvivṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadi trivṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadi caturvṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadi pañcavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadi ṣaḍ-vṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadi saptavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadyaṣṭavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadi navavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadi daśavṛṣo'si sṛjāraso'si yadyekādaśo'si so'podako 'si
verses.en: [Griffith: 'The hymn, which is a charm for the increase and prosperity of cattle, contains ten other similar lines, the only difference being that in the place of ekavrishah, single bull, dvivrishah, double bull, or, worth two bulls, trivrishah, triple bull, or, worth three bulls, and so on, follow in regular order up to ekadasah, eleven-fold, in stanza 11, in which apodakah, waterless, stands instead of the arasah, sapless, of the preceding lines.']

sections.label: The abduction and restoration of a Brahman's wife
sections.name: Hymn 17

verses.sa:
तेऽवदन् प्रथमा ब्रह्मकिल्बिषेऽकूपारः सलिलो मातरिश्वा ।
वीडुहरास्तप उग्रं मयोभूरापो देवीः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य॥
verses.tr: te'vadan prathamā brahmakilbiṣe'kūpāraḥ salilo mātariśvā vīḍuharāstapa ugraṃ mayobhūrāpo devīḥ prathamajā ṛtasya
verses.en: These first, the boundless Sea, and Matarisvan, fierce-glowing Fire, the Strong, the Bliss-bestower, And heavenly Floods, first-born by holy Order, exclaimed against the outrage on a Brahman.

verses.sa:
सोमो राजा प्रथमो ब्रह्मजायां पुनः प्रायच्छदहृणीयमानः ।
अन्वर्तिता वरुणो मित्र आसीदग्निर्होता हस्तगृह्या निनाय॥
verses.tr: somo rājā prathamo brahmajāyāṃ punaḥ prāyacchadahṛṇīyamānaḥ anvartitā varuṇo mitra āsīdagnirhotā hastagṛhyā nināya
verses.en: King Soma first of all, without reluctance, made restitution of the Brahman's consort. Mitra and Varuna were the inviters: Agni as Hotar took her hand and led her.

verses.sa:
हस्तेनैव ग्राह्यऽआधिरस्या ब्रह्मजायेति चेदवोचत्।
न दूताय प्रहेया तस्थ एषा तथा राष्ट्रं गुपितं क्षत्रियस्य॥
verses.tr: hastenaiva grāhya'ādhirasyā brahmajāyeti cedavocat na dūtāya praheyā tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya
verses.en: The man, her pledge, must by the hand be taken when he hath cried, She is a Brahman's consort. She stayed not for a herald to conduct her: thus is the kingdom of a ruler guarded.

verses.sa:
यामाहुस्तारकैषा विकेशीति दुच्छुनां ग्राममवपद्यमानाम्।
सा ब्रह्मजाया वि दुनोति राष्ट्रं यत्र प्रापादि शश उल्कुषीमान्॥
verses.tr: yāmāhustārakaiṣā vikeśīti ducchunāṃ grāmamavapadyamānām sā brahmajāyā vi dunoti rāṣṭraṃ yatra prāpādi śaśa ulkuṣīmān
verses.en: She whom they call the star with loosened tresses, descending as misfortune on the village, The Brahman's consort, she disturbs the kingdom where hath appeared. the hare with fiery flashing.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी चरति वेविषद् विषः स देवानां भवत्येकमङ्गम्।
तेन जाया मन्वविन्दद् बृहस्पतिः सोमेन नीतां जुह्वं१ न देवाः॥
verses.tr: brahmacārī carati veviṣad viṣaḥ sa devānāṃ bhavatyekamaṅgam tena jāyā manvavindad bṛhaspatiḥ somena nītāṃ juhvaṃ1 na devāḥ
verses.en: Active in duty serves the Brahmachari: he is a member ofthe Gods' own body. Through him Brihaspati obtained his consort, as the Gods gained the ladle brought by Soma.

verses.sa:
देवा वा एतस्यामवदन्त पूर्वे सप्तऋषयस्तपसा ये निषेदुः ।
भीमा जाया ब्राह्मणस्यापनीता दुर्धां दधाति परमेव्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: devā vā etasyāmavadanta pūrve saptaṛṣayastapasā ye niṣeduḥ bhīmā jāyā brāhmaṇasyāpanītā durdhāṃ dadhāti paramevyo'man
verses.en: Thus spake of her those Gods of old, Seven Rishis, who sate them down to their austere devotion: Dire is a Brahman's wife led home by others: in the supremest heaven she plants confusion.

verses.sa:
ये गर्भा अवपद्यन्ते जगद् यच्चापलुप्यते ।
वीरा ये तृह्यन्ते मिथो ब्रह्मजाया हिनस्ति तान्॥
verses.tr: ye garbhā avapadyante jagad yaccāpalupyate vīrā ye tṛhyante mitho brahmajāyā hinasti tān
verses.en: When infants die, untimely born, when herds of cattle waste away, When heroes strike each other dead, the Brahman wife destroyeth them.

verses.sa:
उत यत् पतयो दश स्त्रियाः पूर्वे अब्राह्मणाः ।
ब्रह्माचेद्धस्तमग्रहीत् स एव पतिरेकधा॥
verses.tr: uta yat patayo daśa striyāḥ pūrve abrāhmaṇāḥ brahmāceddhastamagrahīt sa eva patirekadhā
verses.en: Even if ten former husbands—none a Brahman—had espoused a dame, And then a Brahman took her hand, he is her husband, only he.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मण एव पतिर्न राजन्यो३ न वैश्यः ।
तत् सूर्यः प्रब्रुवन्नेति पञ्चभ्यो मानवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇa eva patirna rājanyo3 na vaiśyaḥ tat sūryaḥ prabruvanneti pañcabhyo mānavebhyaḥ
verses.en: Not Vaisya, not Rajanya, no, the Brahman is indeed her lord: This Surya in his course proclaims to the Five Races of mankind.

verses.sa:
पुनर्वै देवा अददुः पुनर्मनुष्या अददुः ।
राजानः सत्यं गृह्णाना ब्रह्मजायां पुनर्ददुः॥
verses.tr: punarvai devā adaduḥ punarmanuṣyā adaduḥ rājānaḥ satyaṃ gṛhṇānā brahmajāyāṃ punardaduḥ
verses.en: So then the Gods restored her, so men gave the woman back again. Princes who kept their promises restored the Brahman's wedded wife.

verses.sa:
पुनर्दाय ब्रह्मजायां कृत्वा देवैर्निकिल्बिषम्।
ऊर्जं पृथिव्या भक्त्वोरुगायमुपासते॥
verses.tr: punardāya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvā devairnikilbiṣam ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā bhaktvorugāyamupāsate
verses.en: Having restored the Brahman's wife, and freed them, with Gods' aid, from sin, They shared the fulness of the earth and won themselves extended sway.

verses.sa:
नास्य जाया शतवाही कल्याणी तल्पमा शये ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: nāsya jāyā śatavāhī kalyāṇī talpamā śaye yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā
verses.en: No lovely wife who brings her dower in hundreds rests upon his bed, Within whose kingdom is detained, through want of sense, a Brahman's dame.

verses.sa:
न विकर्णः पृथुशिरास्तस्मिन् वेश्मनि जायते ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: na vikarṇaḥ pṛthuśirāstasmin veśmani jāyate yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā
verses.en: No broad-browed calf with wide-set ears is ever in his homestead born, Within whose kingdom is detained, through want of sense, a Brahman's dame.

verses.sa:
नास्य क्षत्ता निष्कग्रीवः सूनानामेत्यग्रतः ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: nāsya kṣattā niṣkagrīvaḥ sūnānāmetyagrataḥ yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā
verses.en: No steward, golden-neck laced, goes before the meat-trays of the man. Within whose kingdom is detained, through want of sense, a Brahman's dame.

verses.sa:
नास्य श्वेतः कृष्णकर्णो धुरि युक्तो महीयते ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: nāsya śvetaḥ kṛṣṇakarṇo dhuri yukto mahīyate yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā
verses.en: No black-eared courser, white of hue, moves proudly, harnessed to his car, In whose dominion is detained, through want. of sense, a Brahman's dame.

verses.sa:
नास्य क्षेत्रे पुष्करिणी नाण्डीकं जायते बिसम्।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: nāsya kṣetre puṣkariṇī nāṇḍīkaṃ jāyate bisam yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā
verses.en: No lily grows with oval bulbs, no lotus-pool is in his field, In whose dominion is detained, through senseless love, a Brahman's dame.

verses.sa:
नास्मै पृश्निं वि दुहन्ति येऽस्या दोहमुपासते ।
यस्मिन् राष्ट्रे निरुध्यते ब्रह्मजायाचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: nāsmai pṛśniṃ vi duhanti ye'syā dohamupāsate yasmin rāṣṭre nirudhyate brahmajāyācittyā
verses.en: The men whose task it is to milk drain not the brindled cow for him In whose dominion is detained, o senseless love, a Brahman's dame.

verses.sa:
नास्य धेनुः कल्याणी नानड्वान्त्सहते धुरम्।
विजानिर्यत्र ब्रह्मणो रात्रिं वसति पापया॥
verses.tr: nāsya dhenuḥ kalyāṇī nānaḍvāntsahate dhuram vijāniryatra brahmaṇo rātriṃ vasati pāpayā
verses.en: His milch-cow doth not profit one, his draught-ox masters not the yoke Wherever, severed from his wife, a Brahman spends the mournful night.

sections.label: The wickedness of oppressing and robbing Brahmans
sections.name: Hymn 18

verses.sa:
नैतां ते देवा अददुस्तुभ्यं नृपते अत्तवे ।
मा ब्राह्मणस्य राजन्य गां जिघत्सो अनाद्याम्॥
verses.tr: naitāṃ te devā adadustubhyaṃ nṛpate attave mā brāhmaṇasya rājanya gāṃ jighatso anādyām
verses.en: The Gods, O Prince, have not bestowed this cow on thee to eat thereof. Seek not, Rajanya, to devour the Brahman's cow which none may eat.

verses.sa:
अक्षद्रुग्धो राजन्यः पाप आत्मपराजितः ।
स ब्राह्मणस्य गामद्यादद्य जीवानि माश्वः॥
verses.tr: akṣadrugdho rājanyaḥ pāpa ātmaparājitaḥ sa brāhmaṇasya gāmadyādadya jīvāni māśvaḥ
verses.en: A base Rajanya, spoiled at dice, and ruined by himself, may eat. The Brahman's cow, and think, To-day, and not to-morrow, let me live!

verses.sa:
आविष्टिताघविषा पृदाकूरिव चर्मणा ।
सा ब्राह्मणस्य राजन्य तृष्टैषा गौरनाद्या॥
verses.tr: āviṣṭitāghaviṣā pṛdākūriva carmaṇā sā brāhmaṇasya rājanya tṛṣṭaiṣā gauranādyā
verses.en: The Brahman's cow is like a snake, charged with dire poison, clothed with skin. Rajanya! bitter to the taste is she, and none may eat of her.

verses.sa:
निर्वै क्षत्रं नयति हन्ति वर्चोऽग्निरिवारब्धो वि दुनोति सर्वम्।
यो ब्राह्मणं मन्यते अन्नमेव स विषस्य पिबति तैमातस्य॥
verses.tr: nirvai kṣatraṃ nayati hanti varco'gnirivārabdho vi dunoti sarvam yo brāhmaṇaṃ manyate annameva sa viṣasya pibati taimātasya
verses.en: She takes away his strength, she mars his splendour, she ruins everything like fire enkindled. That man drinks poison of the deadly serpent who counts the Brahman as mere food to feed him.

verses.sa:
य एनं हन्ति मृदुं मन्यमानो देवपीयुर्धनकामो न चित्तात्।
सं तस्येन्द्रो हृदयेऽग्निमिन्धे उभे एनं द्विष्टो नभसी चरन्तम्॥
verses.tr: ya enaṃ hanti mṛduṃ manyamāno devapīyurdhanakāmo na cittāt saṃ tasyendro hṛdaye'gnimindhe ubhe enaṃ dviṣṭo nabhasī carantam
verses.en: Whoever smites him, deeming him a weakling—blasphemer, coveting his wealth through folly—Indra sets fire alight within his bosom. He who acts thus is loathed by Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
न ब्राह्मणो हिंसितव्यो३ऽग्निः प्रियतनोरिव ।
सोमो ह्यऽस्य दायाद इन्द्रो अस्याभिशस्तिपाः॥
verses.tr: na brāhmaṇo hiṃsitavyo3'gniḥ priyatanoriva somo hya'sya dāyāda indro asyābhiśastipāḥ
verses.en: No Brahman must be injured, safe as fire from him who loves himself. For Soma is akin to him and Indra guards him from the curse.

verses.sa:
शतापाष्ठां नि गिरति तां न शक्नोति निःखिदम्।
अन्नं यो ब्रह्मणां मल्वः स्वाद्व१द्मीति मन्यते॥
verses.tr: śatāpāṣṭhāṃ ni girati tāṃ na śaknoti niḥkhidam annaṃ yo brahmaṇāṃ malvaḥ svādva1dmīti manyate
verses.en: The fool who eats the Brahmans' food and thinks it pleasant to the taste, Eats, but can ne'er digest, the cow that bristles with a hundred barbs,

verses.sa:
जिह्वा ज्या भवति कुल्मलं वाङ्नाडीका दन्तास्तपसाभिदिग्धाः ।
ते भिर्ब्रह्मा विध्यति देवपीयून् हृद्बलैर्धनुर्भिर्देवजूतैः॥
verses.tr: jihvā jyā bhavati kulmalaṃ vāṅnāḍīkā dantāstapasābhidigdhāḥ te bhirbrahmā vidhyati devapīyūn hṛdbalairdhanurbhirdevajūtaiḥ
verses.en: His voice an arrow's neck, his tongue a bowstring, his windpipes fire-enveloped heads of arrows, With these the Brahman pierces through blasphemers, with God-sped bows that quell the hearts within them,

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णेषवो ब्राह्मणा हेतिमन्तो यामस्यन्ति शरव्यां३ न सा मृषा ।
अनुहाय तपसा मन्युना चोत दूरादव भिन्दन्त्येनम्॥
verses.tr: tīkṣṇeṣavo brāhmaṇā hetimanto yāmasyanti śaravyāṃ3 na sā mṛṣā anuhāya tapasā manyunā cota dūrādava bhindantyenam
verses.en: Keen arrows have the Brahmans, armed with missiles: the shaft, when they discharge it, never faileth. Pursuing him with fiery zeal and anger, they pierce the foeman even from a distance.

verses.sa:
ये सहस्रमराजन्नासन् दशशता उत।
ते ब्राह्मणस्य गां जग्ध्वा वैतहव्याः पराभवन्॥
verses.tr: ye sahasramarājannāsan daśaśatā uta te brāhmaṇasya gāṃ jagdhvā vaitahavyāḥ parābhavan
verses.en: They who, 'themselves ten hundred, were the rulers of a thousand men, The Vaitahavyas, were destroyed for that they ate a Brahman's cow. L I

verses.sa:
गौरेव तान् हन्यमाना वैतहव्याँ अवातिरत्।
ये केसरप्राबन्धायाश्चरमाजामपेचिरन्॥
verses.tr: gaureva tān hanyamānā vaitahavyāṃ avātirat ye kesaraprābandhāyāścaramājāmapeciran
verses.en: The cow, indeed, when she was slain o'erthrew those Vaitahavyas, who Cooked the last she-goat that remained of Kesaraprabandha's flock.

verses.sa:
एकशतं ता जनता या भूमिर्व्यऽधूनुत ।
प्रजां हिंसित्वा ब्राह्मणीमसंभव्यं पराभवन्॥
verses.tr: ekaśataṃ tā janatā yā bhūmirvya'dhūnuta prajāṃ hiṃsitvā brāhmaṇīmasaṃbhavyaṃ parābhavan
verses.en: One anda hundred were the folk, those whom the Earth shook off from her: When they had wronged the Brahman race they perished inconceivably.

verses.sa:
देवपीयुश्चरति मर्त्येषु गरगीर्णो भवत्यस्थिभूयान्।
यो ब्राह्मणं देवबन्धुं हिनस्ति न स पितृयाणमप्येति लोकम्॥
verses.tr: devapīyuścarati martyeṣu garagīrṇo bhavatyasthibhūyān yo brāhmaṇaṃ devabandhuṃ hinasti na sa pitṛyāṇamapyeti lokam
verses.en: Among mankind the Gods' despiser moveth: he hath drunk poison, naught but bone is left him. Who wrongs the kinsman of the Gods, the Brahman, gains not the sphere to which the Fathers travelled.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वै नः पदवायः सोमो दायाद उच्यते ।
हन्ताभिशस्तेन्द्रस्तथा तद् वेधसो विदुः॥
verses.tr: agnirvai naḥ padavāyaḥ somo dāyāda ucyate hantābhiśastendrastathā tad vedhaso viduḥ
verses.en: Agni, in sooth, is called our guide, Soma is called our next of kin. Indra quells him who curses us. Sages know well that this is so.

verses.sa:
इषुरिव दिग्धा नृपते पृदाकूरिव गोपते ।
सा ब्राह्मणस्येषुर्घोरा तया विध्यति पीयतः॥
verses.tr: iṣuriva digdhā nṛpate pṛdākūriva gopate sā brāhmaṇasyeṣurghorā tayā vidhyati pīyataḥ
verses.en: Prince! like a poisoned arrow, like a deadly snake, O lord of kine! Dire is the Brahman's arrow: he pierces his enemies therewith.

sections.label: The wickedness of robbing or insulting Brahmans
sections.name: Hymn 19

verses.sa:
अतिमात्रमवर्धन्त नोदिव दिवमस्पृशन्।
भृगुं हिंसित्वा सृञ्जया वैतहव्याः पराभवन्॥
verses.tr: atimātramavardhanta nodiva divamaspṛśan bhṛguṃ hiṃsitvā sṛñjayā vaitahavyāḥ parābhavan
verses.en: The sons of Vitahavya, the Srinjayas, waxed exceeding strong. They well-nigh touched the heavens, but they wronged Bhrigu and were overthrown.

verses.sa:
ये बृहत्सामानमाङ्गिरसमार्पयन् ब्राह्मणं जनाः ।
पेत्वस्तेषामुभयादमविस्तोकान्यावयत्॥
verses.tr: ye bṛhatsāmānamāṅgirasamārpayan brāhmaṇaṃ janāḥ petvasteṣāmubhayādamavistokānyāvayat
verses.en: When men pierced Brihatsaman through, the Brahman, son of Angiras, The ram with teeth in both his jaws, the sheep, devoured their progeny.

verses.sa:
ये ब्राह्मणं प्रत्यष्ठीवन् ये वास्मिञ्छुल्कमीषिरे।
अस्नस्ते मध्ये कुल्यायाः केशान् खादन्त आसते॥
verses.tr: ye brāhmaṇaṃ pratyaṣṭhīvan ye vāsmiñchulkamīṣire asnaste madhye kulyāyāḥ keśān khādanta āsate
verses.en: If men have spat upon, or shot their rheum upon a Brahman, they Sit in the middle of a stream running with blood, devouring hair.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मगवी पच्यमाना यावत् साभि विजङ्गहे ।
तेजो राष्ट्रस्य निर्हन्ति न वीरो जायते वृषा॥
verses.tr: brahmagavī pacyamānā yāvat sābhi vijaṅgahe tejo rāṣṭrasya nirhanti na vīro jāyate vṛṣā
verses.en: While yet the Brahman's cow which men are dressing quivers in her throes, She mars the kingdom's splendour: there no vigorous hero springs to life.

verses.sa:
क्रूरमस्या आशसनं तृष्टं पिशितमस्यते ।
क्षीरं यदस्याः पीयते तद् वै पितृषु किल्बिषम्॥
verses.tr: krūramasyā āśasanaṃ tṛṣṭaṃ piśitamasyate kṣīraṃ yadasyāḥ pīyate tad vai pitṛṣu kilbiṣam
verses.en: Terrible is her cutting-up: her bitter flesh is cast away, And it is counted sin among the Fathers if her milk is drunk.

verses.sa:
उग्रो राजा मन्यमानो ब्राह्मणं यो जिघत्सति ।
परा तत् सिच्यते राष्ट्रं ब्राह्मणो यत्र जीयते॥
verses.tr: ugro rājā manyamāno brāhmaṇaṃ yo jighatsati parā tat sicyate rāṣṭraṃ brāhmaṇo yatra jīyate
verses.en: If any King who deems himself mighty would eat a Brahman up, Rent and disrupted is that realm wherein a Brahman is oppressed.

verses.sa:
अष्टापदी चतुरक्षी चतुःश्रोत्रा चतुर्हनुः ।
द्व्याऽस्या द्विजिह्वा भूत्वा सा राष्ट्रमव धूनुते ब्रह्मज्यस्य॥
verses.tr: aṣṭāpadī caturakṣī catuḥśrotrā caturhanuḥ dvyā'syā dvijihvā bhūtvā sā rāṣṭramava dhūnute brahmajyasya
verses.en: She grows eight-footed, and four-eyed, four-eared, four-jawed, two-faced, two-tongued, And shatters down the kingdom of the man who doth the Brahman wrong.

verses.sa:
तद् वै राष्ट्रमा स्रवति नावं भिन्नामिवोदकम्।
ब्रह्माणं यत्र हिंसन्ति तद् राष्ट्रं हन्ति दुच्छुना॥
verses.tr: tad vai rāṣṭramā sravati nāvaṃ bhinnāmivodakam brahmāṇaṃ yatra hiṃsanti tad rāṣṭraṃ hanti ducchunā
verses.en: As water swamps a leaky ship so ruin overflows that realm. Misfortune smites the realm wherein a Brahman suffers scath and harm.

verses.sa:
तं वृक्षा अप सेधन्ति छायां नो मोपगा इति ।
यो ब्राह्मणस्य सद् धनमभि नारद मन्यते॥
verses.tr: taṃ vṛkṣā apa sedhanti chāyāṃ no mopagā iti yo brāhmaṇasya sad dhanamabhi nārada manyate
verses.en: The very trees repel the man, and drive him from their sheltering shade, Whoever claims, O Narada, the treasure that a Brahman owns.

verses.sa:
विषमेतद् देवकृतं राजा वरुणोऽब्रवीत्।
न ब्राह्मणस्य गां जग्ध्वा राष्ट्रे जागार कश्चन॥
verses.tr: viṣametad devakṛtaṃ rājā varuṇo'bravīt na brāhmaṇasya gāṃ jagdhvā rāṣṭre jāgāra kaścana
verses.en: That wealth, King Varuna hath said, is poison by the Gods prepared. None hath kept watch to guard his realm who hath devoured a Brahman's cow.

verses.sa:
नवैव ता नवतयो या भूमिर्व्यऽधूनुत ।
प्रजां हिंसित्वा ब्राह्मणीमसंभव्यं पराभवन्॥
verses.tr: navaiva tā navatayo yā bhūmirvya'dhūnuta prajāṃ hiṃsitvā brāhmaṇīmasaṃbhavyaṃ parābhavan
verses.en: Those nine-and-ninety people whom Earth shook and cast away from her, When they had wronged the Brahman race were ruined inconceivably.

verses.sa:
यां मृतायानुबध्नन्ति कूद्यंऽ पदयोपनीम्।
तद् वै ब्रह्मज्य ते देवा उपस्तरणमब्रुवन्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ mṛtāyānubadhnanti kūdyaṃ' padayopanīm tad vai brahmajya te devā upastaraṇamabruvan
verses.en: Oppressor of the Brahmans! thus the Gods have spoken and declared, The step-effacing wisp they bind upon the dead shall be thy couch.

verses.sa:
अश्रूणि कृपमानस्य यानि जीतस्य वावृतुः ।
तं वै ब्रह्मज्य ते देवा अपां भागमधारयन्॥
verses.tr: aśrūṇi kṛpamānasya yāni jītasya vāvṛtuḥ taṃ vai brahmajya te devā apāṃ bhāgamadhārayan
verses.en: Oppressor of the Brahmans! tears wept by the man who suffers wrong, These are the share of water which the Gods have destined 'to be thine.

verses.sa:
येन मृतं स्नपयन्ति श्मश्रूणि येनोन्दते ।
तं वै ब्रह्मज्य ते देवा अपां भागमधारयन्॥
verses.tr: yena mṛtaṃ snapayanti śmaśrūṇi yenondate taṃ vai brahmajya te devā apāṃ bhāgamadhārayan
verses.en: The share of water which the Gods have destined to be thine, is that, Oppressor of the priest! wherewith men lave the corpse and web the beard.

verses.sa:
न वर्षं मैत्रावरुणं ब्रह्मज्यमभि वर्षति ।
नास्मै समितिः कल्पते न मित्रं नयते वशम्॥
verses.tr: na varṣaṃ maitrāvaruṇaṃ brahmajyamabhi varṣati nāsmai samitiḥ kalpate na mitraṃ nayate vaśam
verses.en: The rain of Mitra-varuna falls not on him who wrongs the priest. To him no counsel brings success: he wins no friend to do his will.

sections.label: A hymn to the War-drum to secure victory
sections.name: Hymn 20

verses.sa:
उच्चैर्घोषो दुन्दुभिः सत्वनायन् वानस्पत्यः संभृत उस्रियाभिः ।
वाचं क्षुणुवानो दमयन्त्सपत्नान्त्सिंह इव जेष्यन्नभि तंस्तनीहि॥
verses.tr: uccairghoṣo dundubhiḥ satvanāyan vānaspatyaḥ saṃbhṛta usriyābhiḥ vācaṃ kṣuṇuvāno damayantsapatnāntsiṃha iva jeṣyannabhi taṃstanīhi
verses.en: Formed out of wood, compact with straps of leather, loud is the War-drum as he plays the hero. Whetting thy voice and vanquishing opponents, roar at them like a lion fain to conquer!

verses.sa:
सिंह इवास्तानीद् द्रुवयो विबद्धोऽभिक्रन्दन्नृषभो वासितामिव ।
वृषा त्वं वध्रयस्ते सपत्ना ऐन्द्रस्ते शुष्मो अभिमातिषाहः॥
verses.tr: siṃha ivāstānīd druvayo vibaddho'bhikrandannṛṣabho vāsitāmiva vṛṣā tvaṃ vadhrayaste sapatnā aindraste śuṣmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ
verses.en: The fastened frame hath roared as 'twere a lion, like a bull bellowing to meet the heifer. Thou art a bull, thine enemies are weaklings: thine is the foe-subduing strength of Indra.

verses.sa:
वृषेव यूथे सहसा विदानो गव्यन्नभि रुव संधनाजित्।
शुचा विध्य हृदयं परेषां हित्वा ग्रामान् प्रच्युता यन्तु शत्रवः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣeva yūthe sahasā vidāno gavyannabhi ruva saṃdhanājit śucā vidhya hṛdayaṃ pareṣāṃ hitvā grāmān pracyutā yantu śatravaḥ
verses.en: Like a bull marked by strength among the cattle, roar seeking kine and gathering up the booty. Pierce through our adversaries' heart with sorrow, and let our routed foes desert their hamlets.

verses.sa:
संजयन् पृतना ऊर्ध्वमायुर्गृह्या गृह्णानो बहुधा वि चक्ष्व ।
दैवीं वाचं दुन्दुभ आ गुरस्व वेधाः शत्रूणामुप भरस्व वेदः॥
verses.tr: saṃjayan pṛtanā ūrdhvamāyurgṛhyā gṛhṇāno bahudhā vi cakṣva daivīṃ vācaṃ dundubha ā gurasva vedhāḥ śatrūṇāmupa bharasva vedaḥ
verses.en: Victorious in the battle, loudly roaring, seizing what may be seized, look all around thee. Utter, O Drum, thy heavenly voice with triumph. Bring, as a priest, our enemies' possessions.

verses.sa:
दुन्दुभेर्वाचं प्रयतां वदन्तीमाशृण्वती नाथिता घोषबुद्धा ।
नारी पुत्रं धावतु हस्तगह्यामित्री भीता समरे वधानाम्॥
verses.tr: dundubhervācaṃ prayatāṃ vadantīmāśṛṇvatī nāthitā ghoṣabuddhā nārī putraṃ dhāvatu hastagahyāmitrī bhītā samare vadhānām
verses.en: Hearing the Drum's far-reaching voice resounding, let the foe's dame, waked by the roar, afflicted, Grasping her son, run forward in her terror amid the conflict of the deadly weapons.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो दुन्दुभे प्र वदासि वाचं भूम्याः पृष्ठे वद रोचमानः ।
अमित्रसेनामभिजञ्जभानो द्युमद् वद दुन्दुभे सूनृतावत्॥
verses.tr: pūrvo dundubhe pra vadāsi vācaṃ bhūmyāḥ pṛṣṭhe vada rocamānaḥ amitrasenāmabhijañjabhāno dyumad vada dundubhe sūnṛtāvat
verses.en: Thou, first of all, O Drum, thy voice shalt utter: over the ridge of earth speak forth exultant. Crunching with might the army of the foemen, declare thy message pleasantly and clearly.

verses.sa:
अन्तरेमे नभसी घोषो अस्तु पृथक् ते ध्वनयो यन्तु शीभम्।
अभि क्रन्द स्तनयोत्पिपानः श्लोककृन्मित्रतूर्याय स्वर्धी॥
verses.tr: antareme nabhasī ghoṣo astu pṛthak te dhvanayo yantu śībham abhi kranda stanayotpipānaḥ ślokakṛnmitratūryāya svardhī
verses.en: Loud be thy roar between the earth and heaven. Swift let thy sounds go forth in all directions. Neigh at them, thunder, set in opposition, song-maker, good ally that friends may conquer.

verses.sa:
धीभिः कृतः प्र वदाति वाचमुद्धर्षय सत्वनामायुधानि ।
इन्द्रमेदी सत्वनो नि ह्वयस्व मित्रैरमित्राँ अव जङ्घनीहि॥
