verses.tr: dhībhiḥ kṛtaḥ pra vadāti vācamuddharṣaya satvanāmāyudhāni indramedī satvano ni hvayasva mitrairamitrāṃ ava jaṅghanīhi
verses.en: He shall send forth his voice whom art hath fashioned. Make thou the weapons of our warriors bristle. With Indra for ally call out our heroes, and with thy friends scatter and chase the foemen.

verses.sa:
संक्रन्दनः प्रवदो धृष्णुषेणः प्रवेदकृद् बहुधा ग्रामघोषी।
श्रेयो वन्वानो वयुनानि विद्वान् कीर्तिं बहुभ्यो वि हर द्विराजे॥
verses.tr: saṃkrandanaḥ pravado dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ pravedakṛd bahudhā grāmaghoṣī śreyo vanvāno vayunāni vidvān kīrtiṃ bahubhyo vi hara dvirāje
verses.en: Resonant, roaring, with thy powerful weapons, warning, and heard by troops in many places, Knowing all rules and winning us advantage, deal fame to many where two kings are fighting.

verses.sa:
श्रेयःकेतो वसुजित् सहीयान्त्संग्रामजित् संशितो ब्रह्मणासि ।
अंशूनिव ग्रावाधिषवणे अद्रिर्गव्यन् दुन्दुभेऽधि नृत्य वेदः॥
verses.tr: śreyaḥketo vasujit sahīyāntsaṃgrāmajit saṃśito brahmaṇāsi aṃśūniva grāvādhiṣavaṇe adrirgavyan dundubhe'dhi nṛtya vedaḥ
verses.en: Bent on advantage, mightier, gaining treasures, victor in war, the spell hath made thee keener. As, in the press, the stone to stalks of Soma, thus, Drum! go dancing to our foes' possessions.

verses.sa:
शत्रूषाण् नीषाडभिमातिषाहो गवेषणः सहमान उद्भित्।
वाग्वीव मन्त्रं प्र भरस्व वाचं सांग्रामजित्यायेषमुद् वदेह॥
verses.tr: śatrūṣāṇ nīṣāḍabhimātiṣāho gaveṣaṇaḥ sahamāna udbhit vāgvīva mantraṃ pra bharasva vācaṃ sāṃgrāmajityāyeṣamud vadeha
verses.en: Foe-conqueror, victor, vanquishing opponents, seeker of booty, mastering, destroying, Speak out as a skilled speaker tells his counsel, speak strength to us that we may win the battle.

verses.sa:
अच्युतच्युत् समदो गमिष्ठो मृधो जेता पुरएतायोध्यः ।
इन्द्रेण गुप्तो विदथा निचिक्यद्धृद्द्योतनो द्विषतां याहि शीभम्॥
verses.tr: acyutacyut samado gamiṣṭho mṛdho jetā puraetāyodhyaḥ indreṇa gupto vidathā nicikyaddhṛddyotano dviṣatāṃ yāhi śībham
verses.en: Shaker of things unshaken, readiest comer to battles; conquering foes, resistless leader, Guarded by Indra, watching our assemblies, go quickly, breaker of their hearts who hate us.

sections.label: A hymn to the War-drum and various deities for victory
sections.name: Hymn 21

verses.sa:
विहृदयं वैमनस्यं वदामित्रेषु दुन्दुभे ।
विद्वेषं कश्मशं भयममित्रेषु नि दध्मस्यवैनान् दुन्दुभे जहि॥
verses.tr: vihṛdayaṃ vaimanasyaṃ vadāmitreṣu dundubhe vidveṣaṃ kaśmaśaṃ bhayamamitreṣu ni dadhmasyavainān dundubhe jahi
verses.en: Speak to our enemies, O Drum, discouragement and wild dismay. We bring upon our foemen fear and discord and discomfiture. Drum! drive these enemies away.

verses.sa:
उद्वेपमाना मनसा चक्षुषा हृदयेन च ।
धावन्तु बिभ्यतोऽमित्राः प्रत्रासेनाज्ये हुते॥
verses.tr: udvepamānā manasā cakṣuṣā hṛdayena ca dhāvantu bibhyato'mitrāḥ pratrāsenājye hute
verses.en: When sacrificial butter hath been offered, let our foemen flee Through consternation, terrified, trembling in mind and eye and heart.

verses.sa:
वानस्पत्यः संभृत उस्रियाभिर्विश्वगोत्र्यः ।
प्रत्रासममित्रेभ्यो वदाज्येनाभिघारितः॥
verses.tr: vānaspatyaḥ saṃbhṛta usriyābhirviśvagotryaḥ pratrāsamamitrebhyo vadājyenābhighāritaḥ
verses.en: Wrought out of wood, compact with straps of leather, dear to all the clan, Bedewed with sacrificial oil, speak terror to our enemies.

verses.sa:
यथा मृगाः संविजन्त आरण्याः पुरुषादधि ।
एवा त्वं दुन्दुभेऽमित्रानभि क्रन्द प्र त्रासयाथो चित्तानि मोहय॥
verses.tr: yathā mṛgāḥ saṃvijanta āraṇyāḥ puruṣādadhi evā tvaṃ dundubhe'mitrānabhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya
verses.en: As the wild creatures of the wood flee in their terror from a man, Even so do thou, O Drum, roar out against our foes to frighten them, and then bewilder thou their thoughts,

verses.sa:
यथा वृकादजावयो धावन्ति बहु बिभ्यतीः ।
एवा त्वं दुन्दुभेऽमित्रानभि क्रन्द प्र त्रासयाथो चित्तानि मोहय॥
verses.tr: yathā vṛkādajāvayo dhāvanti bahu bibhyatīḥ evā tvaṃ dundubhe'mitrānabhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya
verses.en: As, when the wolf approaches, goats and sheep run sorely terrified, Even so do thou, O Drum, roar out against our foes to frighten them, and then bewilder thou their thoughts.

verses.sa:
यथा श्येनात् पतत्रिणः संविजन्ते अहर्दिवि सिंहस्य स्तनथोर्यथा ।
एवा त्वं दुन्दुभेऽमित्रानभि क्रन्द प्र त्रासयाथो चित्तानि मोहय॥
verses.tr: yathā śyenāt patatriṇaḥ saṃvijante ahardivi siṃhasya stanathoryathā evā tvaṃ dundubhe'mitrānabhi kranda pra trāsayātho cittāni mohaya
verses.en: As birds of air, day after day, fly in wild terror from the hawk, as from a roaring lion's voice, Even so do thou, O Drum, roar out against our foes to frighten them, and then bewilder thou their thoughts.

verses.sa:
परामित्रान् दुन्दुभिना हरिणस्याजिनेन च ।
सर्वे देवा अतित्रसन् ये संग्रामस्येशते॥
verses.tr: parāmitrān dundubhinā hariṇasyājinena ca sarve devā atitrasan ye saṃgrāmasyeśate
verses.en: May all the deities whose might controls the fortune of the fray Frighten away our enemies with Drum and skin of antelope.

verses.sa:
यैरिन्द्रः प्रक्रीडते पद्घोषैश्छायया सह।
तैरमित्रास्त्रसन्तु नोऽमी ये यन्त्यनीकशः॥
verses.tr: yairindraḥ prakrīḍate padghoṣaiśchāyayā saha tairamitrāstrasantu no'mī ye yantyanīkaśaḥ
verses.en: Let those our enemies who go yonder in their battalions shake In fear at shadows and the sounds of feet which. Indra sporteth with.

verses.sa:
ज्याघोषा दुन्दुभयो भि क्रोशन्तु या दिशः ।
सेनाः पराजिता यतीरमित्राणामनीकशः॥
verses.tr: jyāghoṣā dundubhayo bhi krośantu yā diśaḥ senāḥ parājitā yatīramitrāṇāmanīkaśaḥ
verses.en: To all the quarters of the sky let clang of bowstrings and our Drums. Cry out to hosts of foes that go discomfited in serried ranks.

verses.sa:
आदित्य चक्षुरा दत्स्व मरीचयोऽनु धावत ।
पत्सङ्गिनीरा सजन्तु विगते बाहुवीर्येऽ॥
verses.tr: āditya cakṣurā datsva marīcayo'nu dhāvata patsaṅginīrā sajantu vigate bāhuvīrye'
verses.en: Aditya, take their sight away! Follow them close, ye motes of light. Let them cleave fast to foot-bound hosts when strength of arm hath past away.

verses.sa:
यूयमुग्रा मरुतः पृश्निमातर इन्द्रेण युजा प्र मृणीत शत्रून्।
सोमो राजा वरुणो राजा महादेव उत मृत्युरिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: yūyamugrā marutaḥ pṛśnimātara indreṇa yujā pra mṛṇīta śatrūn somo rājā varuṇo rājā mahādeva uta mṛtyurindraḥ
verses.en: I Do ye, O mighty Maruts, sons of Prisni, crush down, with Indra for ally, our foemen. King Soma, Varuna, great God and sovran, Indra too, aye, Death,

verses.sa:
एता देवसेनाः सूर्यकेतवः सचेतसः ।
अमित्रान् नो जयन्तु स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: etā devasenāḥ sūryaketavaḥ sacetasaḥ amitrān no jayantu svāhā
verses.en: May these embattled Gods, brilliant as Surya—All hail!—one-minded, conquer those who hate us.

sections.label: A charm against fever
sections.name: Hymn 22

verses.sa:
अग्निस्तक्मानमप बाधतामितः सोमो ग्रावा वरुणः पूतदक्षाः ।
वेदिर्बर्हिः समिधः शोशुचाना अप द्वेषांस्यमुया भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: agnistakmānamapa bādhatāmitaḥ somo grāvā varuṇaḥ pūtadakṣāḥ vedirbarhiḥ samidhaḥ śośucānā apa dveṣāṃsyamuyā bhavantu
verses.en: Hence, filled with holy strength let Agni, Soma, and Varuna, the Press-stone, and the Altar, And Grass, and glowing Fuel banish Fever. Let hateful things stay at a distance yonder.

verses.sa:
अयं यो विश्वान् हरितान् कृणोष्युच्छोचयन्नग्निरिवाभिदुन्वन्।
अधा हि तक्मन्नरसो हि भूया अधा न्यऽङ्ङधराङ् वा परेहि॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yo viśvān haritān kṛṇoṣyucchocayannagnirivābhidunvan adhā hi takmannaraso hi bhūyā adhā nya'ṅṅadharāṅ vā parehi
verses.en: And thou thyself who makest all men yellow, consuming them with burning heat like Agni, Thou, Fever! then be weak and ineffective. Pass hence into the realms below or vanish.

verses.sa:
यः परुषः पारुषेयोऽवध्वंस इवारुणः ।
तक्मानं विश्वधावीर्याधराञ्चं परा सुवा॥
verses.tr: yaḥ paruṣaḥ pāruṣeyo'vadhvaṃsa ivāruṇaḥ takmānaṃ viśvadhāvīryādharāñcaṃ parā suvā
verses.en: Endowed with universal power! send Fever downward, far away, The spotty, like red-coloured dust, sprung from a spotty ancestor.

verses.sa:
अधराञ्चं प्र हिणोमि नमः कृत्वा तक्मने ।
शकम्भरस्य मुष्टिहा पुनरेतु महावृषान्॥
verses.tr: adharāñcaṃ pra hiṇomi namaḥ kṛtvā takmane śakambharasya muṣṭihā punaretu mahāvṛṣān
verses.en: When I have paid obeisance to Fever I send him downward forth. So let Sakambhara's boxer go again to the Mahavrishas.

verses.sa:
ओको अस्य मूजवन्त ओको अस्य महावृषाः ।
यावज्जातस्तक्मंस्तावानसि बल्हिकेषु न्योचरः॥
verses.tr: oko asya mūjavanta oko asya mahāvṛṣāḥ yāvajjātastakmaṃstāvānasi balhikeṣu nyocaraḥ
verses.en: His mansions are the Mujavans, and the Mahavrishas his home. Thou, Fever, ever since thy birth hast lived among the Bahlikas.

verses.sa:
तक्मन् व्याऽल वि गद व्यऽङ्ग भूरि यावय ।
दासीं निष्टक्वरीमिछ तां वज्रेण समर्पय॥
verses.tr: takman vyā'la vi gada vya'ṅga bhūri yāvaya dāsīṃ niṣṭakvarīmicha tāṃ vajreṇa samarpaya
verses.en: Fever, snake, limbless one, speak out! Keep thyself far away from us. Seek thou a wanton Dasi girl and strike her with thy thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
तक्मन् मूजवतो गच्छ बल्हिकान् वा परस्तराम्।
शूद्रामिच्छ प्रफर्व्यं१ तां तक्मन् वीऽव धूनुहि॥
verses.tr: takman mūjavato gaccha balhikān vā parastarām śūdrāmiccha prapharvyaṃ1 tāṃ takman vī'va dhūnuhi
verses.en: Go, Fever, to the Majavans, or, farther, to the Bahlikas. Seek a lascivious Sudra girl and seem to shake her through and through.

verses.sa:
महावृषान् मूजवतो बन्ध्वद्धि परेत्य ।
प्रैतानि तक्मने ब्रूमो अन्यक्षेत्राणि वा इमा॥
verses.tr: mahāvṛṣān mūjavato bandhvaddhi paretya praitāni takmane brūmo anyakṣetrāṇi vā imā
verses.en: Go hence and eat thy kinsmen the Mahavrishas and Majavans. These or those foreign regions we proclaim to Fever for his home.

verses.sa:
अन्यक्षेत्रे न रमसे वशी सन्मृडयासि नः ।
अभूदु प्रार्थस्तक्मा स गमिष्यति बल्हिकान्॥
verses.tr: anyakṣetre na ramase vaśī sanmṛḍayāsi naḥ abhūdu prārthastakmā sa gamiṣyati balhikān
verses.en: In a strange land thou joyest not: subdued, thou wilt be kind to us. Fever is eager to depart, and to the Bahlikas will go.

verses.sa:
यत् त्वं शीतोऽथो रूरः सह कासावेपयः ।
भीमास्ते तक्मन् हेतयस्ताभिः स्म परि वृङ्ग्धि नः॥
verses.tr: yat tvaṃ śīto'tho rūraḥ saha kāsāvepayaḥ bhīmāste takman hetayastābhiḥ sma pari vṛṅgdhi naḥ
verses.en: Since thou now cold, now burning hot, with cough besides, hast made us shake, Terrible, Fever, are thy darts: forbear to injure us with these.

verses.sa:
मा स्मैतान्त्सखीन् कुरुथा बलासं कासमुद्युगम्।
मास्मातोऽर्वाङैः पुनस्तत् त्वा तक्मन्नुप ब्रुवे॥
verses.tr: mā smaitāntsakhīn kuruthā balāsaṃ kāsamudyugam māsmāto'rvāṅaiḥ punastat tvā takmannupa bruve
verses.en: Take none of these to be thy friends, Cough, or Consumption, or Decline: Never come thence again to us! O Fever, thus I counsel thee.

verses.sa:
तक्मन् भ्रात्रा बलासेन स्वस्रा कासिकया सह।
पाप्मा भ्रातृव्येण सह गछामुमरणं जनम्॥
verses.tr: takman bhrātrā balāsena svasrā kāsikayā saha pāpmā bhrātṛvyeṇa saha gachāmumaraṇaṃ janam
verses.en: Go, Fever, with Consumption, thy brother, and with thy sister, Cough, And with thy nephew Herpes, go away unto that alien folk.

verses.sa:
तृतीयकं वितृतीयं सदन्दिमुत शारदम्।
तक्मानं शीतं रूरं ग्रैष्मं नाशय वार्षिकम्॥
verses.tr: tṛtīyakaṃ vitṛtīyaṃ sadandimuta śāradam takmānaṃ śītaṃ rūraṃ graiṣmaṃ nāśaya vārṣikam
verses.en: Chase Fever whether cold or hot, brought by the summer or the rains, Tertian, intermittent, or autumnal, or continual.

verses.sa:
गन्धारिभ्यो मूजवद्भ्योऽङ्गेभ्यो मगधेभ्यः ।
प्रैष्यन् जनमिव शेवधिं तक्मानं परि दद्मसि॥
verses.tr: gandhāribhyo mūjavadbhyo'ṅgebhyo magadhebhyaḥ praiṣyan janamiva śevadhiṃ takmānaṃ pari dadmasi
verses.en: We to Gandharis, Mujavans, to Angas and to Magadhas Hand over Fever as it were a servant and a thing of price.

sections.label: A charm against parasitic worms
sections.name: Hymn 23

verses.sa:
ओते मे द्यावापृथिवी ओता देवी सरस्वती ।
ओतौ म इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च क्रिमिं जम्भयतामिति॥
verses.tr: ote me dyāvāpṛthivī otā devī sarasvatī otau ma indraścāgniśca krimiṃ jambhayatāmiti
verses.en: I Have called Heaven and Earth to aid, have called divine Sarasvati, Indra and Agni have I called: Let these destroy the worm, I prayed.

verses.sa:
अस्येन्द्र कुमारस्य क्रिमीन् धनपते जहि ।
हता विश्वा अरातय उग्रेण वचसा मम॥
verses.tr: asyendra kumārasya krimīn dhanapate jahi hatā viśvā arātaya ugreṇa vacasā mama
verses.en: O Indra, Lord of Treasures, kill the worms that prey upon this boy. All the malignant spirits have been smitten by my potent spell.

verses.sa:
यो अक्ष्यौऽपरिसर्पति यो नासे परिसर्पति ।
दतां यो मध्यं गच्छति तं क्रिमिं जम्भयामसि॥
verses.tr: yo akṣyau'parisarpati yo nāse parisarpati datāṃ yo madhyaṃ gacchati taṃ krimiṃ jambhayāmasi
verses.en: We utterly destroy the worm, the worm that creeps around the eyes, The worm that crawls about the nose, the worm that gets between the teeth.

verses.sa:
सरूपौ द्वौ विरूपौ द्वौ कृष्णौ द्वौ रोहितौ द्वौ।
बभ्रुश्च बभ्रुकर्णश्च गृध्रः कोकश्च ते हताः॥
verses.tr: sarūpau dvau virūpau dvau kṛṣṇau dvau rohitau dvau babhruśca babhrukarṇaśca gṛdhraḥ kokaśca te hatāḥ
verses.en: Two of like colour, two unlike, two coloured black, two coloured red, The tawny and the tawny-eared, Vulture and Wolf, all these are killed.

verses.sa:
ये क्रिमयः शितिकक्षा ये कृष्णाः शितिबाहवः ।
ये के च विश्वरूपास्तान् क्रिमीन् जम्भयामसि॥
verses.tr: ye krimayaḥ śitikakṣā ye kṛṣṇāḥ śitibāhavaḥ ye ke ca viśvarūpāstān krimīn jambhayāmasi
verses.en: Worms that are white about the sides, those that are black with black-hued arms, All that show various tints and hues, these worms we utterly destroy.

verses.sa:
उत् पुरस्तात् सूर्य एति विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा।
दृष्टांश्च घ्नन्नदॄष्टांश्च सर्वांश्च प्रमृणन् क्रिमीन्॥
verses.tr: ut purastāt sūrya eti viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā dṛṣṭāṃśca ghnannadṝṣṭāṃśca sarvāṃśca pramṛṇan krimīn
verses.en: Eastward the Sun is mounting, seen of all, destroying things unseen, Crushing and killing all the worms invisible and visible.

verses.sa:
येवाषासः कष्कषास एजत्काः शिपवित्नुकाः ।
दृष्टांश्च हन्यतां क्रिमिरुतादृष्टश्च हन्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yevāṣāsaḥ kaṣkaṣāsa ejatkāḥ śipavitnukāḥ dṛṣṭāṃśca hanyatāṃ krimirutādṛṣṭaśca hanyatām
verses.en: Let the Yevashas, Kaskashas, Ejatkas, Sipavitnukas, Let both the worm that we can see, and that we see not, be destroyed.

verses.sa:
हतो येवाषः क्रिमीणां हतो नदनिमोत।
सर्वान् नि मष्मषाकरं दृषदा खल्वाँ इव॥
verses.tr: hato yevāṣaḥ krimīṇāṃ hato nadanimota sarvān ni maṣmaṣākaraṃ dṛṣadā khalvāṃ iva
verses.en: Slain the Yevasha of the worms, slain too is the Nadaniman. I have reduced them all to dust like vetches with the pounding-stone.

verses.sa:
त्रिशीर्षाणं त्रिककुदं क्रिमिं सारङ्गमर्जुनम्।
शृणाम्यस्य पृष्टीरपि वृश्चामि यच्छिरः॥
verses.tr: triśīrṣāṇaṃ trikakudaṃ krimiṃ sāraṅgamarjunam śṛṇāmyasya pṛṣṭīrapi vṛścāmi yacchiraḥ
verses.en: The worm Saranga, white of hue, three-headed, with a triple hump,—I split and tear his ribs away, I wrench off every head he has.

verses.sa:
अत्रिवद् वः क्रिमयो हन्मि कण्ववज्जमदग्निवत्।
अगस्त्यस्य ब्रह्मणा सं पिनष्म्यहं क्रिमीन्॥
verses.tr: atrivad vaḥ krimayo hanmi kaṇvavajjamadagnivat agastyasya brahmaṇā saṃ pinaṣmyahaṃ krimīn
verses.en: I kill you, worms, as Atri, as Kanva and Jamadagni killed. I crush the worms to pieces with a spell that erst Agastya used.

verses.sa:
हतो राजा क्रिमीणामुतैषां स्थपतिर्हतः ।
हतो हतमाता क्रिमिर्हतभ्राता हतस्वसा॥
verses.tr: hato rājā krimīṇāmutaiṣāṃ sthapatirhataḥ hato hatamātā krimirhatabhrātā hatasvasā
verses.en: The King of worms hath been destroyed, he who. was lord of these is slain. Slain is the worm whose mother, whose brother and sister have been slain.

verses.sa:
हतासो अस्य वेशसो हतासः परिवेशसः ।
अथो ये क्षुल्लका इव सर्वे ते क्रिमयो हताः॥
verses.tr: hatāso asya veśaso hatāsaḥ pariveśasaḥ atho ye kṣullakā iva sarve te krimayo hatāḥ
verses.en: Destroyed are his dependants, those who dwell around him are destroyed, And all the worms that seem to be the little ones are done to death.

verses.sa:
सर्वेषां च क्रिमीणां सर्वासां च क्रिमीनाम्।
भिनद्म्यश्मना शिरो दहाम्यग्निना मुखम्॥
verses.tr: sarveṣāṃ ca krimīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ ca krimīnām bhinadmyaśmanā śiro dahāmyagninā mukham
verses.en: Of every worm and insect, of the female and the male alike, I crush the head to pieces with a stone and burn the face with fire.

sections.label: A priest's prayer for protection and assistance
sections.name: Hymn 24

verses.sa:
सविता प्रसवानामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: savitā prasavānāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: SAvITAR, Lord of furthering aids, protect me, in this my prayer, in this mine act, in this my sacerdotal charge, in this performance, in this thought, in this my plan and wish, in this my calling on the Gods! All hail!

verses.sa:
अग्निर्वनस्पतीनामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agnirvanaspatīnāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Agni, Lord of forest trees, protect me, in, etc,

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिवी दातॄणामधिपत्नि ते मावताम् ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यृं पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dyāvāpṛthivī dātṝṇāmadhipatni te māvatām asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyṛṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth, the Queens of bounties, save me.

verses.sa:
वरुणोऽपामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: varuṇo'pāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Varuna, the Lord of waters, save me.

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणौ वृष्ट्याधिपती तौ मावताम्।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: mitrāvaruṇau vṛṣṭyādhipatī tau māvatām asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Mitra-varuna, Lords of rain, preserve me.

verses.sa:
मरुतः पर्वतानामधिपतयस्ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: marutaḥ parvatānāmadhipatayaste māvantu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Lords of the mountains, may the Maruts save me.

verses.sa:
सोमो वीरुधामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: somo vīrudhāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Soma, Lord of plants and herbs, protect me.

verses.sa:
वायुरन्तरिक्षस्याधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्या
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vāyurantarikṣasyādhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyā cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Vayu, Lord of middle air, protect me.

verses.sa:
सूर्यश्चक्षुषामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: sūryaścakṣuṣāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Surya, sovran Lord of eyes, protect me.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राणामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: candramā nakṣatrāṇāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May the Moon, Lord of constellations, save me.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो दिवोऽधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: indro divo'dhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Indra who is Lord of heaven protect me.

verses.sa:
मरुतां पिता पशूनामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: marutāṃ pitā paśūnāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: The Maruts' father, Lord of cattle, save me.

verses.sa:
मृत्युः प्रजानामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: mṛtyuḥ prajānāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Mrityu, Lord of living creatures, save me.

verses.sa:
यमः पितॄणामधिपतिः स मावतु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yamaḥ pitṝṇāmadhipatiḥ sa māvatu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Yama, Regent of the Fathers, save me.

verses.sa:
पितरः परे ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pitaraḥ pare te māvantu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May the Forefathers of old time protect me.

verses.sa:
तता अवरे ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिस्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: tatā avare te māvantu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratisṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: May Fathers of succeeding ages save me.

verses.sa:
ततस्ततामहास्ते मावन्तु ।
अस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्यस्मिन् कर्मण्यस्यां पुरोधायामस्यां प्रतिष्ठायामस्यां
चित्त्यामस्यामाकूत्यामस्यामाशिष्यस्यां देवहूत्यां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: tatastatāmahāste māvantu asmin brahmaṇyasmin karmaṇyasyāṃ purodhāyāmasyāṃ pratiṣṭhāyāmasyāṃ cittyāmasyāmākūtyāmasyāmāśiṣyasyāṃ devahūtyāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Next may the Fathers of our fathers save me, in this my prayer, in this mine act, in this my sacerdotal charge, in this performance, in this thought, in this my plan and wish, in this my calling on "the Gods! All hail!

sections.label: A charm to facilitate conception
sections.name: Hymn 25

verses.sa:
पर्वताद् दिवो योनेरङ्गादङ्गात् समाभृतम्।
शेपो गर्भस्य रेतोधाः सरौ पर्णमिवा दधत्॥
verses.tr: parvatād divo yoneraṅgādaṅgāt samābhṛtam śepo garbhasya retodhāḥ sarau parṇamivā dadhat
verses.en: Let the man, sower of the germ, lay, as a feather. on a Shaft, Limb drawn from limb, whate'er is culled from cloud and from the womb of heaven:

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही भूतानां गर्भमादधे।
एवा दधामि ते गर्भं तस्मै त्वामवसे हुवे॥
verses.tr: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī bhūtānāṃ garbhamādadhe evā dadhāmi te garbhaṃ tasmai tvāmavase huve
verses.en: Even as this broad earth received the germ of all the things that be, Thus within thee I lay the germ. I call thee, Earth, to strengthen it.

verses.sa:
गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति ।
गर्भं ते अश्विनोभा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा॥
verses.tr: garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati garbhaṃ te aśvinobhā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā
verses.en: O Sinivali, set the germ, set thou the germ, Sarasvati! In thee let both the Asvins, crowned with lotuses, bestow the germ.

verses.sa:
गर्भं ते मित्रावरुणौ गर्भं देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
गर्भं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च गर्भं धाता दधातु ते॥
verses.tr: garbhaṃ te mitrāvaruṇau garbhaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ garbhaṃ ta indraścāgniśca garbhaṃ dhātā dadhātu te
verses.en: Let Mitra-Varuna and God Brihaspati lay the germ in thee. Indra and Agni lay the germ, Dhatar bestow the germ in thee.

verses.sa:
विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु त्वष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु ।
आ सिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते॥
verses.tr: viṣṇuryoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi piṃśatu ā siñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te
verses.en: Let Vishnu form and mould the womb, let Tvashtar duly shape the forms, Prajapati infuse the stream, and Dhatar lay for thee the germ.

verses.sa:
यद् वेद राजा वरुणो यद् वा देवी सरस्वती ।
यदिन्द्रो वृत्रहा वेद तद् गर्भकरणं पिब॥
verses.tr: yad veda rājā varuṇo yad vā devī sarasvatī yadindro vṛtrahā veda tad garbhakaraṇaṃ piba
verses.en: Drink thou the procreative draught well-known to Varuna the King, Known to divine Sarasvati, and Indra slayer of the foe.

verses.sa:
गर्भो अस्योषधीनां गर्भो वनस्पतीनाम्।
गर्भो विश्वस्य भूतस्य सो अग्ने गर्भमेह धाः॥
verses.tr: garbho asyoṣadhīnāṃ garbho vanaspatīnām garbho viśvasya bhūtasya so agne garbhameha dhāḥ
verses.en: Thou art the germ of plants and herbs, thou art the germ of forest trees, The germ of each existing thing, so here, O Agni, lay the germ.

verses.sa:
अधि स्कन्द वीरयस्व गर्भमा धेहि योन्याम्।
वृषासि वृष्ण्यावन् प्रजायै त्वा नयामसि॥
verses.tr: adhi skanda vīrayasva garbhamā dhehi yonyām vṛṣāsi vṛṣṇyāvan prajāyai tvā nayāmasi
verses.en: Rise up, put forth thy manly strength, and lay the germ within the womb. A. bull art thou with vigorous strength: for progeny we bring thee near.

verses.sa:
वि जिहीष्व बार्हत्सामे गर्भस्ते योनिमा शयाम्।
अदुष्टे देवाः पुत्रं सोमपा उभयाविनम्॥
verses.tr: vi jihīṣva bārhatsāme garbhaste yonimā śayām aduṣṭe devāḥ putraṃ somapā ubhayāvinam
verses.en: Prepare thee, Barhatsama, let the germ be laid within thy side. The Soma-drinking Gods have given a son to thee, thy son and mine.

verses.sa:
धातः श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे॥
verses.tr: dhātaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave
verses.en: O Dhatar, thou Disposer, lay within the body of this dame A. male germ with the noblest form, for her, in the tenth month, to bear.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टः श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave
verses.en: Tvashtar, celestial artist, lay within the body of this dame A male germ with the noblest form for her in the tenth month to bear.

verses.sa:
सवितः श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे॥
verses.tr: savitaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave
verses.en: Savitar, vivifier, lay within the body of this dame A male germ with the noblest form for her in the tenth month to bear.

verses.sa:
प्रजापते श्रेष्ठेन रूपेणास्या नार्या गवीन्योः ।
पुमांसं पुत्रमा धेहि दशमे मासि सूतवे॥
verses.tr: prajāpate śreṣṭhena rūpeṇāsyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ pumāṃsaṃ putramā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave
verses.en: O Lord of Life, Prajapati, within this woman's body lay A male germ with the noblest form for her in the tenth month to bear.

sections.label: A hymn of invitation to the Gods
sections.name: Hymn 26

verses.sa: यजूंषि यज्ञे समिधः स्वाहाग्निः प्रविद्वानिह वो युनक्तु॥
verses.tr: yajūṃṣi yajñe samidhaḥ svāhāgniḥ pravidvāniha vo yunaktu
verses.en: In sacrifice for you may sapient Agni—All hail!—use Yajus texts and fuel.

verses.sa: युनक्तु देवः सविता प्रजानन्नस्मिन् यज्ञे महिषः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yunaktu devaḥ savitā prajānannasmin yajñe mahiṣaḥ svāhā
verses.en: May Savitar the God—All hail!—foreknowing, chief in this sacrifice, employ them.

verses.sa: इन्द्र उक्थामदान्यस्मिन् यज्ञे प्रविद्वान् युनक्तु सुयुजः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: indra ukthāmadānyasmin yajñe pravidvān yunaktu suyujaḥ svāhā
verses.en: In this great rite—All hail! may sapient Indra use lauds, rejoicings, well-yoked coursers.

verses.sa: प्रैषा यज्ञे निविदः स्वाहा शिष्टाः पत्नीभिर्वहतेह युक्ताः॥
verses.tr: praiṣā yajñe nividaḥ svāhā śiṣṭāḥ patnībhirvahateha yuktāḥ
verses.en: Bring Praishas in the rite—All hail!—and Divide, learned, connected, with the Consorts.

verses.sa: छन्दांसि यज्ञे मरुतः स्वाहा मातेव पुत्रं पिपृतेह युक्ताः॥
verses.tr: chandāṃsi yajñe marutaḥ svāhā māteva putraṃ pipṛteha yuktāḥ
verses.en: As a dame brings her son—All hail! O mm connected, in the rite bring measures.

verses.sa: एयमगन् बर्हिषा प्रोक्षणीभिर्यज्ञं तन्वानादितिः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: eyamagan barhiṣā prokṣaṇībhiryajñaṃ tanvānāditiḥ svāhā
verses.en: Here Aditi is come—All hail!—preparing the rite with grass and lustral waters.

verses.sa: विष्णुर्युनक्तु बहुधा तपांस्यस्मिन् यज्ञे सुयुजः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: viṣṇuryunaktu bahudhā tapāṃsyasmin yajñe suyujaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Let Vishnu in this rite in varied manner—All hail! use well-yoked steeds, his fervours.

verses.sa: त्वष्टा युनक्तु बहुधा नु रूपा अस्मिन् यज्ञे सुयुजः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā yunaktu bahudhā nu rūpā asmin yajñe suyujaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Let Tvashtar in this rite in varied manner—All hail!—use forms, his well-yoked coursers.

verses.sa: भगो युनक्त्वाशिषो न्व१स्मा अस्मिन् यज्ञे प्रविद्वान् युनक्तु सुयुजः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: bhago yunaktvāśiṣo nva1smā asmin yajñe pravidvān yunaktu suyujaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Let Bhaga in this rite use prayers, foreknowing—All hail! for this use well-yoked coursers.

verses.sa: सोमो युनक्तु बहुधा पयांस्यस्मिन् यज्ञे सुयुजः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: somo yunaktu bahudhā payāṃsyasmin yajñe suyujaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Let Soma in this rite in varied manner—All hail!—use milk-streams, well-yoked coursers.

verses.sa: इन्द्रो युनक्तु बहुधा वीऽर्याण्यस्मिन् यज्ञे सुयुजः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: indro yunaktu bahudhā vī'ryāṇyasmin yajñe suyujaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Let Indra in this rite in varied manner—All hail!—use powers, his well-yoked coursers.

verses.sa:
अश्विना ब्रह्मणा यातमर्वाञ्चौ वषट्कारेण यज्ञं वर्धयतौ ।
बृहस्पते ब्रह्मणा याह्यर्वाङ् यज्ञो अयं स्वऽरिदं यजमानाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: aśvinā brahmaṇā yātamarvāñcau vaṣaṭkāreṇa yajñaṃ vardhayatau bṛhaspate brahmaṇā yāhyarvāṅ yajño ayaṃ sva'ridaṃ yajamānāya svāhā
verses.en: Hitherward come ye with the prayer, O Asvins, exalting sacrifice with cry of Vashat! Brihaspati!—All hail!—with prayer come hither. Here is the rite, here heaven for him who worships.

sections.label: An Apri or Propitiatory Hymn
sections.name: Hymn 27

verses.en: Uplifted be this sacrificed fuel: lofty and brilliant be the flames of Agni! Splendidly bright, fair-faced, with all his offspring, Tanunapat the Asura, many-handed.
God among Gods, the God bedews the paths with fatness and with mead.
With store of mead to sacrifice comes Agni, comes Narasansa Agni, friendly-minded, comes Savitar, righteous God who brings all blessings.
Hither he comes with power and fatness also, the luminous, implored with adoration.
At holy rites and offerings Agni loveth the scoops: let this man worship Agni's greatness.
He is the furtherer at glad oblations: there stood the Vasus and the treasure-givers.
Ever the Doors divine, and all protect this worshipper's holy work.
Far-reaching, ruling by the Law of Agni, May Dawn and Night, the holy, speeding near us, aid this our sacrificial ceremony.
Celestial Hotars, with the tongues of Agni praise and extol our lofty ceremony, so that our sacrifice be well conducted!
Three Goddesses upon this grass be seated, Ida, Sarasvati, Mahi, and Bharati adored with praise.
This our nutritious genial flow, God Tvashtar! and growth of wealth, pour down on this man's kindred.
Vanaspati, rejoicing, of thyself send God-ward! Let Agni, Immolator, sweeten our libation.
Pay sacrifice to Indra, Jatavedas Agni, with Hail! Let all the Gods accept the gifts we offer.

sections.label: A charm to ensure general protection and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 28

verses.sa:
नव प्राणान् नवभिः सं मिमीते दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ।
हरिते त्रीणि रजते त्रीण्ययसि त्रीणि तपसाविष्ठितानि॥
verses.tr: nava prāṇān navabhiḥ saṃ mimīte dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya harite trīṇi rajate trīṇyayasi trīṇi tapasāviṣṭhitāni
verses.en: For lengthened life, to last through hundred autumns, they equalize with nine the nine spirations. Three in gold, three in silver, three in iron by heat are stablished in their several places.

verses.sa:
अग्निः सूर्यश्चन्द्रमा भूमिरापो द्यौरन्तरिक्षं प्रदिशो दिशश्च ।
आर्तवा ऋतुभिः संविदाना अनेन मा त्रिवृता पारयन्तु॥
verses.tr: agniḥ sūryaścandramā bhūmirāpo dyaurantarikṣaṃ pradiśo diśaśca ārtavā ṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānā anena mā trivṛtā pārayantu
verses.en: May Agni, Sun, and Moon, and Earth, and Waters, Sky, Air, the Quarters and the Points between them, And Parts of Years accordant with the Seasons by this three-threaded Amulet preserve me.

verses.sa:
त्रयः पोषास्त्रिवृति श्रयन्तामनक्तु पूषा पयसा घृतेन ।
अन्नस्य भूमा पुरुषस्य भूमा भूमा पशूनां त इह श्रयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: trayaḥ poṣāstrivṛti śrayantāmanaktu pūṣā payasā ghṛtena annasya bhūmā puruṣasya bhūmā bhūmā paśūnāṃ ta iha śrayantām
verses.en: In the three-threaded Charm rest triple fulness! Let Pushan cover it with milk and butter. Here rest abundant store of food and people, may ample store of cattle rest within it.

verses.sa:
इममादित्या वसुना समुक्षतेममग्ने वर्धय ववृधानः ।
इममिन्द्र सं सृज वीर्येऽणास्मिन् त्रिवृच्छ्रयतां पोषयिष्णु॥
verses.tr: imamādityā vasunā samukṣatemamagne vardhaya vavṛdhānaḥ imamindra saṃ sṛja vīrye'ṇāsmin trivṛcchrayatāṃ poṣayiṣṇu
verses.en: Enrich this charm, Adityas, with your treasure; magnify this, when magnified, O. Agni. Endow it with heroic strength, O Indra: therein be lodged a triple power of increase.

verses.sa:
भूमिष्ट्वा पातु हरितेन विश्वभृदग्निः पिपर्त्वयसा सजोषाः ।
वीरुद्भिष्टे अर्जुनं संविदानं दक्षं दधातु सुमनस्यमानम्॥
verses.tr: bhūmiṣṭvā pātu haritena viśvabhṛdagniḥ pipartvayasā sajoṣāḥ vīrudbhiṣṭe arjunaṃ saṃvidānaṃ dakṣaṃ dadhātu sumanasyamānam
verses.en: With gold let Earth protect thee, and with iron, accordant, all-sustaining Agni save thee! And in accordance with the plants may silver, regarding thee with favour, grant thee vigour.

verses.sa:
त्रेधा जातं जन्मनेदं हिरण्यमग्नेरेकं प्रियतमं बभूव सोमस्यैकं हिंसितस्य परापतत्।
अपामेकं वेधसां रेत आहुस्तत् ते हिरण्यं त्रिवृदस्त्वायुषे॥
verses.tr: tredhā jātaṃ janmanedaṃ hiraṇyamagnerekaṃ priyatamaṃ babhūva somasyaikaṃ hiṃsitasya parāpatat apāmekaṃ vedhasāṃ reta āhustat te hiraṇyaṃ trivṛdastvāyuṣe
verses.en: This gold, born threefold at its first production, grew the one thing that Agni loved most dearly: it fell away, one part of injured Soma. One part they call seed of the sapient Waters. This gold bring thee long life when triply threaded!

verses.sa:
त्र्यायुषं जमदग्नेः कश्यपस्य त्र्यायुषम्।
त्रेधामृतस्य चक्षणं त्रीण्यायूंषि ते ऽकरम्॥
verses.tr: tryāyuṣaṃ jamadagneḥ kaśyapasya tryāyuṣam tredhāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ trīṇyāyūṃṣi te 'karam
verses.en: Three lives of Jamadagni, thrice the vital force of Kasyapa, Three sights of immortality, three lives have I prepared for thee.

verses.sa:
त्रयः सुपर्णास्त्रिवृता यदायन्नेकाक्षरमभिसंभूय शक्राः ।
प्रत्यौहन् मृत्युममृतेन साकमन्तर्दधाना दुरितानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: trayaḥ suparṇāstrivṛtā yadāyannekākṣaramabhisaṃbhūya śakrāḥ pratyauhan mṛtyumamṛtena sākamantardadhānā duritāni viśvā
verses.en: When with the three-stringed charm came three strong eagles, sharing the Sacred Syllable and mighty, With immortality they drove off Mrityu, obscuring, and concealing all distresses.

verses.sa:
दिवस्त्वा पातु हरितं मध्यात् त्वा पात्वर्जुनम्।
भूम्या अयस्मयं पातु प्रागाद् देवपुरा अयम्॥
verses.tr: divastvā pātu haritaṃ madhyāt tvā pātvarjunam bhūmyā ayasmayaṃ pātu prāgād devapurā ayam
verses.en: The golden guard the from the sky, the silvern guard thee from the air, The iron guard thee from the earth! This man hath reached the forts of Gods.

verses.sa:
इमास्तिस्रो देवपुरास्तास्त्वा रक्षन्तु सर्वतः ।
तास्त्वं बिभ्रद् वर्चस्व्युत्तरो द्विषतां भव॥
verses.tr: imāstisro devapurāstāstvā rakṣantu sarvataḥ tāstvaṃ bibhrad varcasvyuttaro dviṣatāṃ bhava
verses.en: May these three castles of the Gods keep thee secure on every side. Endowed with strength, possessing these, be thou? the master of thy foes.

verses.sa:
पुरं देवानाममृतं हिरण्यं य आबेधे प्रथमो देवो अग्रे ।
तस्मै नमो दश प्राचीः कृणोम्यनु मन्यतां त्रिवृदाबधे मे॥
verses.tr: puraṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ya ābedhe prathamo devo agre tasmai namo daśa prācīḥ kṛṇomyanu manyatāṃ trivṛdābadhe me
verses.en: The God who first bound on in the beginning the deities' immortal golden castle,—Him I salute with ten extended fingers. Blest be the three-stringed charm I bind upon thee.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा चृतत्वर्यमा पूषा बृहस्पतिः ।
अहर्जातस्य यन्नाम तेन त्वाति चृतामसि॥
verses.tr: ā tvā cṛtatvaryamā pūṣā bṛhaspatiḥ aharjātasya yannāma tena tvāti cṛtāmasi
verses.en: Aryaman be thy binder-on, and Pashan and Brihaspati: Whatever name the brood of day possess, therewith we fasten thee.

verses.sa:
ऋतुभिष्ट्वार्तवैरायुषे वर्चसे त्वा ।
संवत्सरस्य तेजसा तेन संहनु कृण्मसि॥
verses.tr: ṛtubhiṣṭvārtavairāyuṣe varcase tvā saṃvatsarasya tejasā tena saṃhanu kṛṇmasi
verses.en: With Seasons and with. Lengths of Time, for vigour and extended life, With all the splendour of the Sun we fasten thee about the neck.

verses.sa:
घृतादुल्लुप्तं मधुना समक्तं भूमिदृंहमच्युतं पारयिष्णु।
भिन्दत् सपत्नानधरांश्च कृण्वदा मा रोह महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: ghṛtādulluptaṃ madhunā samaktaṃ bhūmidṛṃhamacyutaṃ pārayiṣṇu bhindat sapatnānadharāṃśca kṛṇvadā mā roha mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: Drawn forth from butter and with meath besprinkled, firm as the earth, unslayable; triumphant, Breaking down foes and casting them beneath me, be fastened on me for exalted fortune!

sections.label: A charm for the destruction of malignant goblins
sections.name: Hymn 29

verses.en: Made ready in the east drive forth, take notice of what is happening here, omniscient Agni! Thou bringest medicine and healest sickness: through thee may we win horses, kine, and people.
Accordant with all Gods, O Jatavedas Agni perform this work as we beseech thee, That this defence of his may fall, whoever hath caused us pain, whoever hath consumed as.
Unanimous, with all the Gods together, so do this thing O Agni Jatavedas, that this defence of his may fall and fail him.
Pierce both his eyes, pierce thou the heart within him, crush thou his teeth and cleave his tongue asunder. Rend thou, most youthful Agni, that Pisacha whoso amid them all of this hath eaten.

Whatever of his body hath been taken, plundered, borne off, or eaten by Pisachas, This, Agni, knowing it, again bring hither! We give back flesh and spirit to his body. G If some Pisacha in my food raw, ready, thoroughly cooked, or, spotty, hath deceived me, Let the Pisachas with their lives and offspring atone for this, and let this man be healthy.
If one hath cheated me in milk or porridge, in food from grain or plants that need no culture, Let the Pisachas, etc.

If one, flesh-eater, in a draught of water have wronged me lying in the bed of goblins, Let the Pisachas, etc,,0 If one, flesh-eater, in the day or night-time have wronged me lying in the bed of goblins, Let the Pisachas, etc.
O Agni Jatavedas, slay the bloody Pisacha, flesh-devourer, mind-destroyer. Strong Indra strike him with his bolt of thunder, courageous Soma cut his head to pieces!
Thou, Agni, ever slayest Yatudhanas, the fiends have never conquered thee in battles. Consume thou from the root the flesh-devourers, let none of them escape thy heavenly weapon.
Collect, O Jatavedas, what hath been removed and borne away. Let this man's members grow, let him swell like the tendril of a plant.
Like as the Soma's tendril, thus, O Jatavedas, let him swell. Let him live, Agni! Make him fat, free from consumption, full of sap.
Here, Agni, is the fuel, here are logs that crush Pisachas down. O Jatavedas, willingly accept them and be pleased therewith.
Accept, O Agni, with thy flame the billets of Tarshtagha wood. Let the flesh-eater who would take the flesh of this man lose his form.

sections.label: A charm to restore life and health
sections.name: Hymn 30

verses.sa:
आवतस्त आवतः परावतस्त आवतः ।
इहैव भव मा नु गा मा पूर्वाननु गाः पितॄनसुं बध्नामि ते दृढम्॥
verses.tr: āvatasta āvataḥ parāvatasta āvataḥ ihaiva bhava mā nu gā mā pūrvānanu gāḥ pitṝnasuṃ badhnāmi te dṛḍham
verses.en: From thy vicinity I call, from near, from far, from nigh at hand. Stay here: depart not: follow not the Fathers of the olden time. I bind thy vital spirit fast.

verses.sa:
यत् त्वाभिचेरुः पुरुषः स्वो यदरणो जनः ।
उन्मोचनप्रमोचने उभे वाचा वदामि ते॥
verses.tr: yat tvābhiceruḥ puruṣaḥ svo yadaraṇo janaḥ unmocanapramocane ubhe vācā vadāmi te
verses.en: If any man, a stranger or akin, hath cast a spell on thee, I with my voice to thee declare thy freedom and release therefrom.

verses.sa:
यद् दुद्रोहिथ शेपिषे स्त्रियै पुंसे अचित्त्या ।
उन्मोचनप्रमोचने उभे वाचा वदामि ते॥
verses.tr: yad dudrohitha śepiṣe striyai puṃse acittyā unmocanapramocane ubhe vācā vadāmi te
verses.en: If in thy folly thou hast lied or cursed a woman or a man, I with my voice declare to thee thy freedom and release therefrom.

verses.sa:
यदेनसो मातृकृताच्छेषे पितृकृताच्च यत्।
उन्मोचनप्रमोचने उभे वाचा वदामि ते॥
verses.tr: yadenaso mātṛkṛtāccheṣe pitṛkṛtācca yat unmocanapramocane ubhe vācā vadāmi te
verses.en: If thou art lying there because of mother's or of father's sin, I with my voice declare to thee thy freedom and release therefrom.

verses.sa:
यत् ते माता यत् ते पिता जामिर्भ्राता च सर्जतः ।
प्रत्यक् सेवस्व भेषजं जरदष्टिं कृणोमि त्वा॥
verses.tr: yat te mātā yat te pitā jāmirbhrātā ca sarjataḥ pratyak sevasva bheṣajaṃ jaradaṣṭiṃ kṛṇomi tvā
verses.en: Accept the healing medicine, the balm thy mother and thy sire, Thy sister and thy brother bring. I make thee live through lengthened years.

verses.sa:
इहैधि पुरुष सर्वेण मनसा सह।
दूतौ यमस्य मानु गा अधि जीवपुरा इहि॥
verses.tr: ihaidhi puruṣa sarveṇa manasā saha dūtau yamasya mānu gā adhi jīvapurā ihi
verses.en: O man, stay here among us; stay with all thy spirit: follow not Yama's two messengers. Approach the castles where the living dwell.

verses.sa:
अनुहूतः पुनरेहि विद्वानुदयनं पथः ।
आरोहणमाक्रमणं जीवतोजीवतोऽयनम्॥
verses.tr: anuhūtaḥ punarehi vidvānudayanaṃ pathaḥ ārohaṇamākramaṇaṃ jīvatojīvato'yanam
verses.en: Come back as thou art called to come, knowing the outlet of the path, And the approach and its ascent, the way of every living man.

verses.sa:
मा बिभेर्न मरिष्यसि जरदष्टिं कृणोमि त्वा ।
निरवोचमहं यक्ष्ममङ्गेभ्यो अङ्गज्वरं तव॥
verses.tr: mā bibherna mariṣyasi jaradaṣṭiṃ kṛṇomi tvā niravocamahaṃ yakṣmamaṅgebhyo aṅgajvaraṃ tava
verses.en: Be not alarmed: thou wilt not die. I give thee lengthened years of life. Forth from thy members have I charmed Decline that caused the fever there.

verses.sa:
अङ्गभेदो अङ्गज्वरो यश्च ते हृदयामयः ।
यक्ष्मः श्येन इव प्रापप्तद् वाचा साढः परस्तराम्॥
verses.tr: aṅgabhedo aṅgajvaro yaśca te hṛdayāmayaḥ yakṣmaḥ śyena iva prāpaptad vācā sāḍhaḥ parastarām
verses.en: Gone is the pain that racked thee, gone thy fever, gone thy heart's disease. Consumption, conquered by my voice, hath, like a hawk, fled far away.

verses.sa:
ऋषी बोधप्रतीबोधावस्वप्नो यश्च जागृविः ।
तौ ते प्राणस्य गोप्तारौ दिवा नक्तं च जागृताम्॥
verses.tr: ṛṣī bodhapratībodhāvasvapno yaśca jāgṛviḥ tau te prāṇasya goptārau divā naktaṃ ca jāgṛtām
verses.en: Two sages, Sense and Vigilance, the sleepless and the watchful one, These, the protectors of thy life, shall be awake both day and night.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निरुपसद्य इह सूर्य उदेतु ते ।
उदेहि मृत्योर्गम्भीरात् कृष्णाच्चित् तमसस्परि॥
verses.tr: ayamagnirupasadya iha sūrya udetu te udehi mṛtyorgambhīrāt kṛṣṇāccit tamasaspari
verses.en: This Agni must be waited on. Here let the Sun mount up for the-: Rise from deep death and come away, yea, from black darkness rise thou up!

verses.sa:
नमो यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे नमः पितृभ्य उत ये नयन्ति ।
उत्पारणस्य यो वेद तमग्निं पुरो दधेऽस्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: namo yamāya namo astu mṛtyave namaḥ pitṛbhya uta ye nayanti utpāraṇasya yo veda tamagniṃ puro dadhe'smā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: Homage be paid to Yama, and to Mrityu, and to the Fathers, and to those who guide us! I honour first, for this man's preservation, that Agni who well knoweth how to save him.

verses.sa:
ऐतु प्राण ऐतु मन ऐतु चक्षुरथो बलम्।
शरीरमस्य सं विदां तत् पद्भ्यां प्रति तिष्ठतु॥
verses.tr: aitu prāṇa aitu mana aitu cakṣuratho balam śarīramasya saṃ vidāṃ tat padbhyāṃ prati tiṣṭhatu
verses.en: Let breath and mind return to him, let sight and vigour come again. Let all his body be restored and firmly stand upon its feet.

verses.sa:
प्राणेनाग्ने चक्षुषा सं सृजेमं समीरय तन्वा३सं बलेन ।
वेत्थामृतस्य मा नु गान्मा नु भूमिगृहो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: prāṇenāgne cakṣuṣā saṃ sṛjemaṃ samīraya tanvā3saṃ balena vetthāmṛtasya mā nu gānmā nu bhūmigṛho bhuvat
verses.en: Provide this man with breath and sight, O Agni, and with his body and his strength unite him. Thou knowest Amrit: let him not go hence, nor dwell in house of clay.

verses.sa:
मा ते प्राण उप दसन्मो अपानोऽपि धायि ते ।
सूर्यस्त्वाधिपतिर्मृत्योरुदायच्छतु रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: mā te prāṇa upa dasanmo apāno'pi dhāyi te sūryastvādhipatirmṛtyorudāyacchatu raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: Let not thine inward breathing fail, let not thine outward breath be lost. Let Surya who is Lord Supreme raise thee from death with beams of light.

verses.sa:
इयमन्तर्वदति जिह्वा बद्धा पनिष्पदा।
त्वया यक्ष्मं निरवोचं शतं रोपीश्च तक्मनः॥
verses.tr: iyamantarvadati jihvā baddhā paniṣpadā tvayā yakṣmaṃ niravocaṃ śataṃ ropīśca takmanaḥ
verses.en: Tied, tremulously moving, here the tongue is speaking in the mouth. With thee I charmed Decline away and Fever' hundred agonies.

verses.sa:
अयं लोकः प्रियतमो देवानामपराजितः ।
यस्मै त्वमिह मृत्यवे दिष्टः पुरुष जज्ञिषे।
स च त्वानु ह्वयामसि मा पुरा जरसो मृथाः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ lokaḥ priyatamo devānāmaparājitaḥ yasmai tvamiha mṛtyave diṣṭaḥ puruṣa jajñiṣe sa ca tvānu hvayāmasi mā purā jaraso mṛthāḥ
verses.en: This living world, unconquered of the Gods, is most beloved of all. To whatsoever death thou wast destined when thou wast born, O man, This death and we call after thee. Die not before decrepit age!

sections.label: A counter-charm to secure protection from all kinds of spells
sections.name: Hymn 31

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरामे पात्रे यां चक्रुर्मिश्रधान्ये ।
आमे मांसे कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakrurāme pātre yāṃ cakrurmiśradhānye āme māṃse kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The spell that they have cast for thee on unbaked dish or mingled meal, The witchcraft wrought on undressed meat, this I strike back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः कृकवाकावजे वा यां कुरीरिणि ।
अव्यां ते कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakruḥ kṛkavākāvaje vā yāṃ kurīriṇi avyāṃ te kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The spell that they have cast for thee on jungle-cock, goat, horned ram, The witchcraft wrought upon thy ewe, this I strike back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरेकशफे पशूनामुभयादति ।
गर्दभे कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakrurekaśaphe paśūnāmubhayādati gardabhe kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The spell that they have cast upon thy beast that hath uncloven hooves, The ass with teeth in both his jaws, this I strike back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुरमूलायां वलगं वा नराच्याम्।
क्षेत्रे ते कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakruramūlāyāṃ valagaṃ vā narācyām kṣetre te kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The secret spell upon thy plants Amula or Narachi, spell That they have cast upon thy field, this I strike back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुर्गार्हपत्ये पूर्वाग्नावुत दुश्चितः ।
शालायां कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakrurgārhapatye pūrvāgnāvuta duścitaḥ śālāyāṃ kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The spell that wicked men have cast on thine original household-fire, And on thy sacrificial hall, this I strike back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः सभायां यां चक्रुरधिदेवने ।
अक्षेषु कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakruḥ sabhāyāṃ yāṃ cakruradhidevane akṣeṣu kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The spell that they have cast upon thy public room, thy gambling-board, Spell they have cast upon thy dice, this I strike back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः सेनायां यां चक्रुरिष्वायुधे।
दुन्दुभौ कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakruḥ senāyāṃ yāṃ cakruriṣvāyudhe dundubhau kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The spell that they have cast upon thine army or thy shafts and arms, Spell they have cast upon the drum, this I throw back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते कृत्यां कूपेऽवदधुः श्मशाने वा निचख्नुः ।
सद्मनि कृत्यां यां चक्रुः पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te kṛtyāṃ kūpe'vadadhuḥ śmaśāne vā nicakhnuḥ sadmani kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakruḥ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: Charm they have laid within thy well or buried in the burning-ground, Charm they have laid within thy home, this I throw back again on them.

verses.sa:
यां ते चक्रुः पुरुषास्थे अग्नौ संकसुके च याम्।
म्रोकं निर्दाहं क्रव्यादं पुनः प्रति हरामि ताम्॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te cakruḥ puruṣāsthe agnau saṃkasuke ca yām mrokaṃ nirdāhaṃ kravyādaṃ punaḥ prati harāmi tām
verses.en: The spell that they have wrought for thee in flickering fire of human bones,—Mroka, consuming, cannibal, this I throw back again on them.

verses.sa:
अपथेना जभारैणां तां पथेतः प्र हिण्मसि ।
अधीरो मर्याधीरेभ्यः सं जभाराचित्त्या॥
verses.tr: apathenā jabhāraiṇāṃ tāṃ pathetaḥ pra hiṇmasi adhīro maryādhīrebhyaḥ saṃ jabhārācittyā
verses.en: He brought this by no proper path, by the right path we drive it back. The fool in folly brought it to those who observe established bounds.

verses.sa:
यश्चकार न शशाक कर्तुं शश्रे पादमङ्गुरिम्।
चकार भद्रमस्मभ्यमभगो भगवद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: yaścakāra na śaśāka kartuṃ śaśre pādamaṅgurim cakāra bhadramasmabhyamabhago bhagavadbhyaḥ
verses.en: No power had he who wrought the spell: he hurt his foot, he broke his toe. Unlucky for his wealthy 'lords, he hath wrought happiness for us.

verses.sa:
कृत्याकृतं वलगिनं मूलिनं शपथेय्यऽम्।
इन्द्रस्तं हन्तु महता वधेनाग्निर्विध्यत्वस्तया॥
verses.tr: kṛtyākṛtaṃ valaginaṃ mūlinaṃ śapatheyya'm indrastaṃ hantu mahatā vadhenāgnirvidhyatvastayā
verses.en: May Indra slay with mighty bolt, may Agni with his missile pierce The sorcerer who brings the curse, who deals with roots and secret spells.
